derivation: 给定 $n+1$ 个互异节点 $x_0<x_1<\cdots<x_n$ 及函数值 $y_i$，求次数不超过 $n$ 的多项式 $P$，使 $$P(x_i)=y_i,\qquad i=0,1,\dots,n.$$ 若 $P,Q$ 都满足条件，则 $R=P-Q$ 的次数不超过 $n$，却有 $n+1$ 个互异零点 $x_0,\dots,x_n$；非零多项式最多有 $n$ 个零点，故 $R\equiv0$，即 $P=Q$。存在性可由拉格朗日构造给出；也可把系数方程写成范德蒙德矩阵，其行列式 $$\prod_{0\le j<i\le n}(x_i-x_j)\ne0,$$ 故解存在唯一。

拉格朗日插值。对每个 $k=0,\dots,n$ 定义 $$l_k(x)=\prod_{j\ne k}\frac{x-x_j}{x_k-x_j}.$$ 每个 $l_k$ 是 $n$ 次多项式，且 $$l_k(x_i)=\delta_{ki}=\begin{cases}1,&i=k,\\0,&i\ne k.\end{cases}$$ 于是 $$P(x)=\sum_{k=0}^n y_kl_k(x)$$ 满足 $P(x_i)=y_i$，这就是拉格朗日插值多项式。由唯一性，它与任何其他形式的插值多项式相同。基函数还满足 $\sum_{k=0}^n l_k(x)\equiv1$，因为常数 $1$ 的插值多项式就是它自己。

牛顿差商形式。定义零阶差商 $f[x_i]=y_i$，并递推 $$f[x_i,\dots,x_{i+k}]=\frac{f[x_{i+1},\dots,x_{i+k}]-f[x_i,\dots,x_{i+k-1}]}{x_{i+k}-x_i}.$$ 则 $$N(x)=f[x_0]+\sum_{k=1}^n f[x_0,\dots,x_k]\prod_{i=0}^{k-1}(x-x_i).$$ 逐项次数不超过 $n$，且由差商递推可验证 $N(x_i)=y_i$：若 $N_{k-1}$ 插值前 $k$ 个节点，则增加项在旧节点 $x_0,\dots,x_{k-1}$ 处为零，而在 $x_k$ 处由差商定义恰好补到 $y_k$；由唯一性 $N=P$。差商表按对角线计算，增加一个新节点只需在表尾续算一行，故适合逐步加密节点；建表 $O(n^2)$，用嵌套乘法求值 $O(n)$。

插值余项。设 $f\in C^{n+1}[a,b]$，节点与 $x$ 都在 $[a,b]$ 内，$P$ 是插值多项式。若 $x$ 是节点，则 $R(x)=0$ 且 $\omega(x)=0$，公式两边都为零，故成立。否则令 $$\begin{aligned}\omega(t)&=\prod_{i=0}^n(t-x_i),\\ F(t)&=f(t)-P(t)-\frac{f(x)-P(x)}{\omega(x)}\omega(t).\end{aligned}$$ 则 $F(x)=0$，且 $F(x_i)=0$（$i=0,\dots,n$），共有 $n+2$ 个互异零点。反复用罗尔定理 $n+1$ 次，存在 $\xi$ 介于 $x$ 与全部节点之间，使 $F^{(n+1)}(\xi)=0$。因为 $P^{(n+1)}=0$、$\omega^{(n+1)}=(n+1)!$，所以 $$0=f^{(n+1)}(\xi)-\frac{f(x)-P(x)}{\omega(x)}(n+1)!,$$ 即 $$R(x)=f(x)-P(x)=\frac{f^{(n+1)}(\xi)}{(n+1)!}\omega(x).$$ 这里 $\xi$ 依赖于 $x$，一般不能具体求出。

误差上界与龙格现象。若 $|f^{(n+1)}|\le M_{n+1}$，则 $$|R(x)|\le\frac{M_{n+1}}{(n+1)!}|\omega(x)|.$$ 误差在节点处为零，在节点之间由 $\omega$ 放大。等距节点并不保证增加节点就收敛：对 $f(x)=\frac1{1+25x^2}$ 在 $[-1,1]$ 上取等距节点，$n=10$ 时插值多项式在两端剧烈振荡，最大偏差约 $1.9$，这就是龙格现象；其原因是 $f$ 在 $\pm\mathrm{i}/5$ 处有奇点，靠近区间，高阶差商不衰减。切比雪夫节点 $$x_k=\cos\frac{(2k+1)\pi}{2(n+1)},\qquad k=0,\dots,n,$$ 在 $[-1,1]$ 上向两端聚集，使 $\max_{[-1,1]}|\omega(x)|$ 达到所有首一 $n+1$ 次多项式中的最小值 $2^{-n}$，从而抑制端点振荡；对 $[a,b]$ 作仿射变换即可。对解析函数，切比雪夫节点插值在适当的椭圆域内收敛；对仅连续的函数，节点加密仍可能不收敛（Faber 定理），所以节点选择只能改善、不能无条件保证收敛。

例：节点 $(0,1)$、$(1,2)$、$(2,5)$。拉格朗日基为 $$\begin{aligned}l_0&=\frac{(x-1)(x-2)}2,\quad l_1=x(2-x),\\ l_2&=\frac{x(x-1)}2,\end{aligned}$$ 故 $$P=l_0+2l_1+5l_2=x^2+1.$$ 差商为 $f[0,1]=1$、$f[1,2]=3$、$f[0,1,2]=(3-1)/2=1$，牛顿形式 $$N(x)=1+1\cdot x+1\cdot x(x-1)=x^2+1,$$ 与拉格朗日形式一致。实际计算中，直接解范德蒙德方程或使用单项式基底在 $n$ 较大时条件数很差；拉格朗日形式每次求值 $O(n^2)$，牛顿形式建表 $O(n^2)$、用嵌套乘法求值 $O(n)$，增加节点只需 $O(n)$ 续算；重心拉格朗日公式在数值上更稳定。选择形式应兼顾节点是否固定、是否需要反复求值与数值稳定性。
derivationEn: Given $n+1$ distinct nodes $x_0<x_1<\cdots<x_n$ and values $y_i$, find a polynomial $P$ of degree at most $n$ such that $$P(x_i)=y_i,\qquad i=0,1,\dots,n.$$ If $P,Q$ both satisfy the conditions, then $R=P-Q$ has degree at most $n$ but has the $n+1$ distinct zeros $x_0,\dots,x_n$; a nonzero polynomial has at most $n$ zeros, so $R\equiv0$ and $P=Q$. Existence follows from the Lagrange construction; equivalently, the coefficient equations have a Vandermonde matrix with determinant $$\prod_{0\le j<i\le n}(x_i-x_j)\ne0,$$ so the solution exists and is unique.

Lagrange interpolation. For each $k=0,\dots,n$ define $$l_k(x)=\prod_{j\ne k}\frac{x-x_j}{x_k-x_j}.$$ Each $l_k$ is a polynomial of degree $n$, and $$l_k(x_i)=\delta_{ki}=\begin{cases}1,&i=k,\\0,&i\ne k.\end{cases}$$ Hence $$P(x)=\sum_{k=0}^n y_kl_k(x)$$ satisfies $P(x_i)=y_i$ and is the Lagrange interpolating polynomial. By uniqueness it coincides with every other form of the interpolating polynomial. The basis also satisfies $\sum_{k=0}^n l_k(x)\equiv1$, since the interpolating polynomial of the constant function $1$ is $1$ itself.

Newton divided-difference form. Define the zeroth divided difference $f[x_i]=y_i$ and the recursion $$f[x_i,\dots,x_{i+k}]=\frac{f[x_{i+1},\dots,x_{i+k}]-f[x_i,\dots,x_{i+k-1}]}{x_{i+k}-x_i}.$$ Then $$N(x)=f[x_0]+\sum_{k=1}^n f[x_0,\dots,x_k]\prod_{i=0}^{k-1}(x-x_i).$$ Each term has degree at most $n$, and the divided-difference recursion shows $N(x_i)=y_i$: if $N_{k-1}$ interpolates the first $k$ nodes, the added term vanishes at the old nodes $x_0,\dots,x_{k-1}$ and, by the definition of the divided difference, supplies exactly the value $y_k$ at $x_k$. By uniqueness $N=P$. The divided-difference table is computed along diagonals, and adding a new node only requires extending one row at the end, which is convenient when nodes are added progressively. Building the table costs $O(n^2)$, and nested multiplication evaluates it in $O(n)$.

Interpolation remainder. Let $f\in C^{n+1}[a,b]$, with the nodes and $x$ in $[a,b]$, and let $P$ be the interpolating polynomial. If $x$ is a node, then $R(x)=0$ and $\omega(x)=0$, so both sides of the formula vanish and it holds. Otherwise set $$\begin{aligned}\omega(t)&=\prod_{i=0}^n(t-x_i),\\ F(t)&=f(t)-P(t)-\frac{f(x)-P(x)}{\omega(x)}\omega(t).\end{aligned}$$ Then $F(x)=0$ and $F(x_i)=0$ for $i=0,\dots,n$, giving $n+2$ distinct zeros. Applying Rolle's theorem $n+1$ times, there is $\xi$ between $x$ and the nodes such that $F^{(n+1)}(\xi)=0$. Since $P^{(n+1)}=0$ and $\omega^{(n+1)}=(n+1)!$, $$0=f^{(n+1)}(\xi)-\frac{f(x)-P(x)}{\omega(x)}(n+1)!,$$ that is, $$R(x)=f(x)-P(x)=\frac{f^{(n+1)}(\xi)}{(n+1)!}\omega(x).$$ Here $\xi$ depends on $x$ and generally cannot be determined explicitly.

Error bound and Runge phenomenon. If $|f^{(n+1)}|\le M_{n+1}$, then $$|R(x)|\le\frac{M_{n+1}}{(n+1)!}|\omega(x)|.$$ The error vanishes at the nodes and is amplified between them by $\omega$. Equidistant nodes do not guarantee convergence as $n$ increases: for $f(x)=\frac1{1+25x^2}$ on $[-1,1]$ with equidistant nodes, the interpolating polynomial oscillates violently near the endpoints at $n=10$, with maximum deviation about $1.9$; this is the Runge phenomenon. Its cause is that $f$ has singularities at $\pm\mathrm{i}/5$ close to the interval, so high-order divided differences do not decay. Chebyshev nodes $$x_k=\cos\frac{(2k+1)\pi}{2(n+1)},\qquad k=0,\dots,n,$$ cluster toward the endpoints of $[-1,1]$ and make $\max_{[-1,1]}|\omega(x)|$ attain the minimum $2^{-n}$ among all monic polynomials of degree $n+1$, thereby suppressing endpoint oscillations; an affine map handles a general $[a,b]$. For analytic functions, Chebyshev interpolation converges in a suitable elliptic region; for merely continuous functions, refining the nodes may still fail to converge (Faber's theorem), so node choice can improve but cannot unconditionally guarantee convergence.

Example: nodes $(0,1)$, $(1,2)$, $(2,5)$. The Lagrange basis is $$\begin{aligned}l_0&=\frac{(x-1)(x-2)}2,\quad l_1=x(2-x),\\ l_2&=\frac{x(x-1)}2,\end{aligned}$$ hence $$P=l_0+2l_1+5l_2=x^2+1.$$ The divided differences are $f[0,1]=1$, $f[1,2]=3$, $f[0,1,2]=(3-1)/2=1$, so the Newton form is $$N(x)=1+1\cdot x+1\cdot x(x-1)=x^2+1,$$ consistent with the Lagrange form. In practice, solving the Vandermonde equations directly or using the monomial basis becomes badly conditioned for large $n$; the Lagrange form costs $O(n^2)$ per evaluation, while the Newton form costs $O(n^2)$ to build the table and $O(n)$ to evaluate by nested multiplication, and adding a node costs only $O(n)$ to extend the table. The barycentric Lagrange formula is numerically more stable. The choice of form should balance whether the nodes are fixed, whether repeated evaluation is needed, and numerical stability.

formulas.note: 插值问题的提法。系数矩阵是范德蒙德矩阵，行列式不为零，所以插值多项式存在且唯一。
formulas.noteEn: The interpolation problem. The coefficient matrix is Vandermonde with nonzero determinant, so the interpolating polynomial exists and is unique.

formulas.note: 拉格朗日基函数：每个 $l_k$ 在 $x_k$ 处为 1、在其它节点处为 0；基函数之和恒等于 1。
formulas.noteEn: Lagrange basis functions: $l_k$ equals 1 at $x_k$ and 0 at the other nodes, and the basis sums to 1 identically.

formulas.note: 拉格朗日插值公式：由基函数的 $\delta$ 性质，代入每个节点都恰好得到 $y_k$。
formulas.noteEn: Lagrange's formula: the delta property of the basis makes $P(x_i)=y_i$ for every node.

formulas.note: 插值余项（误差公式）：要求 $f$ 有 $n+1$ 阶导数，$\xi$ 介于 $x$ 与节点之间。可推出误差上界 $|R(x)|\le\frac{M_{n+1}}{(n+1)!}|\omega(x)|$。
formulas.noteEn: The interpolation remainder: it needs $n+1$ derivatives of $f$, with $\xi$ between $x$ and the nodes. It yields the bound $|R(x)|\le\frac{M_{n+1}}{(n+1)!}|\omega(x)|$.

formulas.note: 牛顿差商形式与差商递推；与拉格朗日形式给出同一个多项式，只是按节点逐个添加。
formulas.noteEn: Newton's divided-difference form and the recursion; it gives the same polynomial as the Lagrange form, built node by node.

properties: 存在唯一性：$n+1$ 个互异节点唯一决定一个次数不超过 $n$ 的插值多项式；证明用范德蒙德行列式或「两个解之差有 $n+1$ 个零点」。
拉格朗日基满足 $l_k(x_i)=\delta_{ki}$ 且 $\sum_k l_k(x)\equiv1$：前者保证插值、后者说明常函数能被精确重现。
余项公式 $R(x)=\frac{f^{(n+1)}(\xi)}{(n+1)!}\omega(x)$ 给出误差结构：节点处误差为零，节点之间由 $\omega$ 放大；$\xi$ 未知，一般用于估计误差上界。
拉格朗日与牛顿形式给出同一个多项式；牛顿差商形式便于逐步添加节点（差商表只加一行），适合流水式计算。
龙格现象：等距节点上高阶插值多项式可能剧烈振荡、随节点加密不收敛（如 $1/(1+25x^2)$ 在 $[-1,1]$ 上），所以实用中更常用分段低次插值、三次样条或切比雪夫节点。
propertiesEn: Existence and uniqueness: $n+1$ distinct nodes determine exactly one interpolant of degree at most $n$; prove it via the Vandermonde determinant or by noting that the difference of two solutions has $n+1$ zeros.
The Lagrange basis satisfies $l_k(x_i)=\delta_{ki}$ and $\sum_k l_k(x)\equiv1$: the first property gives interpolation, the second shows constants are reproduced exactly.
The remainder $R(x)=\frac{f^{(n+1)}(\xi)}{(n+1)!}\omega(x)$ reveals the error structure: zero at the nodes and amplified in between by $\omega$; $\xi$ is unknown, so it is used for error bounds.
The Lagrange and Newton forms give the same polynomial; the divided-difference form makes adding a node cheap (extend one row of the table), ideal for incremental computation.

Runge phenomenon: with equally spaced nodes a high-degree interpolant can oscillate badly and fail to converge as nodes are added (e.g. $1/(1+25x^2)$ on $[-1,1]$); piecewise low-degree interpolation, cubic splines or Chebyshev nodes are the practical cure.

examples.problem: 已知 $f$ 在 $x=1,2,4$ 处取值 $0,2,12$，用差商表写出牛顿插值多项式。

expression.note: 拉格朗日表示：插值多项式是基函数的线性组合，系数就是节点函数值 $y_k$。
expression.noteEn: Lagrange representation: the interpolant is a linear combination of the basis functions with the data values as coefficients.

spline-interpolation.definition:
三次样条的思路是把区间分段，每段用一个低次多项式，再让相邻两段在节点处光滑地接起来。设节点 $x_0<x_1<\cdots<x_n$ 与函数值 $y_0,\dots,y_n$。若函数 $S$ 满足：
1. 在每个子区间 $[x_i,x_{i+1}]$ 上 $S$ 是三次多项式
$$S_i(x)=a_i+b_i(x-x_i)+c_i(x-x_i)^2+d_i(x-x_i)^3;$$
2. 插值条件 $S(x_i)=y_i$（$i=0,\dots,n$）；
3. **整体二阶连续可导**，即 $S\in C^2[x_0,x_n]$：每个内节点处 $S$、$S'$、$S''$ 都连续；
则称 $S$ 为**三次样条插值函数**。

自由度计数：$n$ 段共有 $4n$ 个待定系数，插值条件 $n+1$ 条、内节点连续性条件 $3(n-1)$ 条，共 $4n-2$ 条，因此还缺 **2 个边界条件**。常用的三类是：**自然边界** $S''(x_0)=S''(x_n)=0$；**固定（夹持）边界** $S'(x_0)=y_0'$、$S'(x_n)=y_n'$（端点导数已知）；**周期边界** $S'(x_0)=S'(x_n)$、$S''(x_0)=S''(x_n)$（适用于周期数据）。在这三类边界条件下，三次样条插值函数都存在且唯一。

实际求解用**三弯矩方程**：记 $h_i=x_{i+1}-x_i$，$M_i=S''(x_i)$，则每个内节点满足
$$\mu_i M_{i-1}+2M_i+\lambda_i M_{i+1}=d_i,$$
其中 $\mu_i=\dfrac{h_{i-1}}{h_{i-1}+h_i}$，$\lambda_i=1-\mu_i$，$d_i=\dfrac{6}{h_{i-1}+h_i}\Big[\dfrac{y_{i+1}-y_i}{h_i}-\dfrac{y_i-y_{i-1}}{h_{i-1}}\Big]$。系数矩阵三对角且**严格对角占优**，故存在唯一并可用追赶法（Thomas 算法）以 $O(n)$ 的代价解出全部 $M_i$，再代回分段公式
$$S_i(x)=\frac{M_i(x_{i+1}-x)^3+M_{i+1}(x-x_i)^3}{6h_i}+\Big(\frac{y_i}{h_i}-\frac{M_ih_i}{6}\Big)(x_{i+1}-x)+\Big(\frac{y_{i+1}}{h_i}-\frac{M_{i+1}h_i}{6}\Big)(x-x_i).$$

若 $f\in C^4$，固定边界下的误差满足 $\max|f-S|\le\dfrac{5}{384}h^4\max|f^{(4)}|$（$h=\max h_i$），即 $O(h^4)$ 的高阶收敛，而且不会像高阶多项式插值那样出现端点振荡。
spline-interpolation.definitionEn:
Cubic spline interpolation splits the interval into pieces, uses a low-degree polynomial on each piece, and joins the pieces smoothly at the nodes. Given nodes $x_0<x_1<\cdots<x_n$ with values $y_0,\dots,y_n$, a function $S$ is called a **cubic spline interpolant** if:
1. on each subinterval $[x_i,x_{i+1}]$, $S$ is a cubic polynomial
$$S_i(x)=a_i+b_i(x-x_i)+c_i(x-x_i)^2+d_i(x-x_i)^3;$$
2. $S(x_i)=y_i$ for $i=0,\dots,n$;
3. **$S$ is twice continuously differentiable**, i.e. $S\in C^2[x_0,x_n]$: at every interior node $S$, $S'$ and $S''$ are continuous.

Counting degrees of freedom: $n$ pieces carry $4n$ coefficients, while interpolation gives $n+1$ conditions and continuity at interior nodes gives $3(n-1)$ conditions — $4n-2$ in total. So **two boundary conditions** are still needed. The three standard choices are: **natural boundary** $S''(x_0)=S''(x_n)=0$; **clamped boundary** $S'(x_0)=y_0'$, $S'(x_n)=y_n'$ (known endpoint slopes); **periodic boundary** $S'(x_0)=S'(x_n)$, $S''(x_0)=S''(x_n)$ (periodic data). Under any of these, the cubic spline interpolant exists and is unique.

Computationally one solves the **three-moment equations**. Let $h_i=x_{i+1}-x_i$ and $M_i=S''(x_i)$; then at every interior node
$$\mu_i M_{i-1}+2M_i+\lambda_i M_{i+1}=d_i,$$
with $\mu_i=\dfrac{h_{i-1}}{h_{i-1}+h_i}$, $\lambda_i=1-\mu_i$, $d_i=\dfrac{6}{h_{i-1}+h_i}\Big[\dfrac{y_{i+1}-y_i}{h_i}-\dfrac{y_i-y_{i-1}}{h_{i-1}}\Big]$. The coefficient matrix is tridiagonal and strictly diagonally dominant, so the solution is unique and the Thomas algorithm computes all $M_i$ in $O(n)$ time; substituting back gives
$$S_i(x)=\frac{M_i(x_{i+1}-x)^3+M_{i+1}(x-x_i)^3}{6h_i}+\Big(\frac{y_i}{h_i}-\frac{M_ih_i}{6}\Big)(x_{i+1}-x)+\Big(\frac{y_{i+1}}{h_i}-\frac{M_{i+1}h_i}{6}\Big)(x-x_i).$$

If $f\in C^4$, the clamped spline satisfies $\max|f-S|\le\dfrac{5}{384}h^4\max|f^{(4)}|$ with $h=\max h_i$ — high-order $O(h^4)$ convergence without the endpoint oscillations of high-degree polynomial interpolation.
derivation: 设节点 $x_0<x_1<\cdots<x_n$，函数值 $y_i$。三次样条 $S$ 满足：在每个子区间 $[x_i,x_{i+1}]$ 上 $S$ 是三次多项式 $$S_i(x)=a_i+b_i(x-x_i)+c_i(x-x_i)^2+d_i(x-x_i)^3,$$ 且 $S(x_i)=y_i$、$S\in C^2[x_0,x_n]$（在每个内节点处 $S,S',S''$ 连续）。共有 $n$ 段、$4n$ 个系数；插值条件 $n+1$ 条，内节点连续性条件 $3(n-1)$ 条，合计 $4n-2$ 条，还缺 $2$ 个条件，必须由边界条件补足。

常用边界条件有三类：自然边界 $$S''(x_0)=S''(x_n)=0;$$ 固定（夹持）边界 $$S'(x_0)=y_0',\qquad S'(x_n)=y_n';$$ 周期边界 $$S'(x_0)=S'(x_n),\qquad S''(x_0)=S''(x_n),$$ 并需 $y_0=y_n$ 使函数值也周期。补上任意一类（两个条件）后，三次样条插值函数存在且唯一；若不添加边界条件，则仍有 $2$ 个自由参数，解不唯一。自然边界适合端点曲率未知的情形；固定边界在端点斜率已知时精度更高；周期边界用于周期数据。

三弯矩方程。记 $h_i=x_{i+1}-x_i$、$M_i=S''(x_i)$。在 $[x_i,x_{i+1}]$ 上 $S''$ 是线性的：$$S_i''(x)=\frac{M_i(x_{i+1}-x)+M_{i+1}(x-x_i)}{h_i}.$$ 积分两次并用 $S_i(x_i)=y_i$、$S_i(x_{i+1})=y_{i+1}$ 定出常数，得 $$\begin{aligned}S_i(x)&=\frac{M_i(x_{i+1}-x)^3+M_{i+1}(x-x_i)^3}{6h_i}\\ &\quad+\Bigl(\frac{y_i}{h_i}-\frac{M_ih_i}{6}\Bigr)(x_{i+1}-x)\\ &\quad+\Bigl(\frac{y_{i+1}}{h_i}-\frac{M_{i+1}h_i}{6}\Bigr)(x-x_i).\end{aligned}$$ 由它求端点导数：$$\begin{aligned}S_i'(x_i)&=-\frac{M_ih_i}{3}-\frac{M_{i+1}h_i}{6}+\frac{y_{i+1}-y_i}{h_i},\\ S_{i-1}'(x_i)&=\frac{M_{i-1}h_{i-1}}{6}+\frac{M_ih_{i-1}}{3}+\frac{y_i-y_{i-1}}{h_{i-1}}.\end{aligned}$$ 在内节点令二者相等，整理得 $$\mu_iM_{i-1}+2M_i+\lambda_iM_{i+1}=d_i,$$ 其中 $$\mu_i=\frac{h_{i-1}}{h_{i-1}+h_i},\quad \lambda_i=1-\mu_i,\quad d_i=\frac{6}{h_{i-1}+h_i}\Bigl(\frac{y_{i+1}-y_i}{h_i}-\frac{y_i-y_{i-1}}{h_{i-1}}\Bigr).$$ 这就是三弯矩方程，$i=1,\dots,n-1$。

方程组与唯一性。内节点方程组成三对角系统，第 $i$ 行为 $(\mu_i,2,\lambda_i)$。因为 $\mu_i,\lambda_i>0$ 且 $\mu_i+\lambda_i=1$，有 $$|2|>\mu_i+\lambda_i=1,$$ 即矩阵严格对角占优，故非奇异、解唯一。自然边界令 $M_0=M_n=0$，得到 $(n-1)\times(n-1)$ 的三对角系统；固定边界补充 $$\begin{aligned}2M_0+M_1&=\frac6{h_0}\Bigl(\frac{y_1-y_0}{h_0}-y_0'\Bigr),\\ M_{n-1}+2M_n&=\frac6{h_{n-1}}\Bigl(y_n'-\frac{y_n-y_{n-1}}{h_{n-1}}\Bigr),\end{aligned}$$ 对应的首末行仍是严格对角占优。于是可用追赶法（Thomas 算法）按 $O(n)$ 求解：前向消元把次对角线消掉，再回代。周期边界给出循环三对角系统，每行非对角元之和仍为 $1$，也严格对角占优；但因有角元，需用循环追赶或周期消元，计算量仍为 $O(n)$，在周期数据相容时解唯一。

误差与性质。若 $f\in C^4$，固定边界三次样条的误差满足 $$\begin{aligned}\max_{x\in[x_0,x_n]}|f(x)-S(x)|&\le\frac5{384}h^4\max_x|f^{(4)}(x)|,\\ h&=\max_i h_i,\end{aligned}$$ 即 $O(h^4)$；分段线性插值只有 $O(h^2)$。自然边界在内部仍是 $O(h^4)$，但在端点附近，若 $f''(x_0)\ne0$ 或 $f''(x_n)\ne0$，强制 $S''=0$ 会使误差降到 $O(h^2)$；若端点二阶导数恰为零，则可保持更高阶。三次样条不会出现高次多项式插值的龙格式端点振荡。自然三次样条还有最小弯曲性质：在所有满足插值条件的 $C^2$ 函数中，它使 $$\int_{x_0}^{x_n}[S''(x)]^2\,dx$$ 最小（端点 $S''=0$ 是该变分问题的自然边界条件）；固定边界样条则在满足给定端点斜率的函数类中最小化同一泛函。

例：求过 $(0,0)$、$(1,1)$、$(2,0)$ 的自然三次样条。$h_0=h_1=1$，$M_0=M_2=0$，内节点方程（$\mu_1=\lambda_1=\frac12$）为 $$\frac12M_0+2M_1+\frac12M_2=\frac62\Bigl(\frac{0-1}{1}-\frac{1-0}{1}\Bigr)=-6,$$ 故 $M_1=-3$。代入分段公式：$$S(x)=\begin{cases}\frac32x-\frac12x^3,&0\le x\le1,\\-\frac12(2-x)^3+\frac32(2-x),&1\le x\le2.\end{cases}$$ 验证：$S(0)=0$、$S(1)=1$、$S(2)=0$；在 $x=1$ 处两段的 $S'=0$、$S''=-3$ 相等；$S''(0)=S''(2)=0$，自然边界成立。该样条也是所有过这三点的 $C^2$ 函数中 $\int_0^2(S'')^2\,dx$ 最小的一个。
derivationEn: Let $x_0<x_1<\cdots<x_n$ be nodes with values $y_i$. A cubic spline $S$ satisfies: on each subinterval $[x_i,x_{i+1}]$, $S$ is a cubic polynomial $$S_i(x)=a_i+b_i(x-x_i)+c_i(x-x_i)^2+d_i(x-x_i)^3,$$ with $S(x_i)=y_i$ and $S\in C^2[x_0,x_n]$ (at every interior node $S,S',S''$ are continuous). There are $n$ pieces and $4n$ coefficients; interpolation gives $n+1$ conditions, and interior continuity gives $3(n-1)$ conditions, for a total of $4n-2$. Two more conditions are still missing and must be supplied by boundary conditions.

There are three standard types of boundary conditions: natural, $$S''(x_0)=S''(x_n)=0;$$ clamped, $$S'(x_0)=y_0',\qquad S'(x_n)=y_n';$$ and periodic, $$S'(x_0)=S'(x_n),\qquad S''(x_0)=S''(x_n),$$ with $y_0=y_n$ also required for periodic function values. Adding any one pair of conditions makes the cubic spline interpolant exist and be unique; without boundary conditions, two free parameters remain and the solution is not unique. Natural conditions are appropriate when the endpoint curvature is unknown; clamped conditions give higher accuracy when endpoint slopes are known; periodic conditions are used for periodic data.

Three-moment equations. Let $h_i=x_{i+1}-x_i$ and $M_i=S''(x_i)$. On $[x_i,x_{i+1}]$, $S''$ is linear: $$S_i''(x)=\frac{M_i(x_{i+1}-x)+M_{i+1}(x-x_i)}{h_i}.$$ Integrating twice and using $S_i(x_i)=y_i$, $S_i(x_{i+1})=y_{i+1}$ to determine the constants gives $$\begin{aligned}S_i(x)&=\frac{M_i(x_{i+1}-x)^3+M_{i+1}(x-x_i)^3}{6h_i}\\ &\quad+\Bigl(\frac{y_i}{h_i}-\frac{M_ih_i}{6}\Bigr)(x_{i+1}-x)\\ &\quad+\Bigl(\frac{y_{i+1}}{h_i}-\frac{M_{i+1}h_i}{6}\Bigr)(x-x_i).\end{aligned}$$ Its endpoint derivatives are $$\begin{aligned}S_i'(x_i)&=-\frac{M_ih_i}{3}-\frac{M_{i+1}h_i}{6}+\frac{y_{i+1}-y_i}{h_i},\\ S_{i-1}'(x_i)&=\frac{M_{i-1}h_{i-1}}{6}+\frac{M_ih_{i-1}}{3}+\frac{y_i-y_{i-1}}{h_{i-1}}.\end{aligned}$$ Equating them at each interior node and rearranging gives $$\mu_iM_{i-1}+2M_i+\lambda_iM_{i+1}=d_i,$$ where $$\mu_i=\frac{h_{i-1}}{h_{i-1}+h_i},\quad \lambda_i=1-\mu_i,\quad d_i=\frac{6}{h_{i-1}+h_i}\Bigl(\frac{y_{i+1}-y_i}{h_i}-\frac{y_i-y_{i-1}}{h_{i-1}}\Bigr).$$ These are the three-moment equations for $i=1,\dots,n-1$.

The system and uniqueness. The interior equations form a tridiagonal system whose $i$-th row is $(\mu_i,2,\lambda_i)$. Since $\mu_i,\lambda_i>0$ and $\mu_i+\lambda_i=1$, $$|2|>\mu_i+\lambda_i=1,$$ so the matrix is strictly diagonally dominant, hence nonsingular with a unique solution. Natural boundary conditions set $M_0=M_n=0$, leaving an $(n-1)\times(n-1)$ tridiagonal system; clamped boundary conditions add $$\begin{aligned}2M_0+M_1&=\frac6{h_0}\Bigl(\frac{y_1-y_0}{h_0}-y_0'\Bigr),\\ M_{n-1}+2M_n&=\frac6{h_{n-1}}\Bigl(y_n'-\frac{y_n-y_{n-1}}{h_{n-1}}\Bigr),\end{aligned}$$ and the first and last rows remain strictly diagonally dominant. Hence the Thomas algorithm solves the system in $O(n)$ time: forward elimination removes the subdiagonal, followed by back substitution. Periodic boundary conditions give a cyclic tridiagonal system; each row still has off-diagonal entries summing to $1$, so it is strictly diagonally dominant, but the corner entries require cyclic reduction or a periodic version of the Thomas algorithm, still $O(n)$; the solution is unique when the periodic data are compatible.

Error and properties. If $f\in C^4$, the clamped cubic spline satisfies $$\begin{aligned}\max_{x\in[x_0,x_n]}|f(x)-S(x)|&\le\frac5{384}h^4\max_x|f^{(4)}(x)|,\\ h&=\max_i h_i,\end{aligned}$$ i.e. $O(h^4)$; piecewise linear interpolation is only $O(h^2)$. The natural spline is still $O(h^4)$ in the interior, but near the endpoints, if $f''(x_0)\ne0$ or $f''(x_n)\ne0$, forcing $S''=0$ can reduce the order to $O(h^2)$; if the endpoint second derivatives happen to vanish, higher order can be retained. Cubic splines do not exhibit the endpoint oscillations of high-degree polynomial interpolation. The natural cubic spline also has the minimum-curvature property: among all $C^2$ functions satisfying the interpolation conditions, it minimizes $$\int_{x_0}^{x_n}[S''(x)]^2\,dx,$$ with $S''=0$ at the endpoints arising as the natural boundary condition of this variational problem; the clamped spline minimizes the same functional among functions with the prescribed endpoint slopes.

Example: find the natural cubic spline through $(0,0)$, $(1,1)$, $(2,0)$. Here $h_0=h_1=1$, $M_0=M_2=0$, and the interior equation ($\mu_1=\lambda_1=\frac12$) is $$\frac12M_0+2M_1+\frac12M_2=\frac62\Bigl(\frac{0-1}{1}-\frac{1-0}{1}\Bigr)=-6,$$ so $M_1=-3$. Substituting into the piecewise formula gives $$S(x)=\begin{cases}\frac32x-\frac12x^3,&0\le x\le1,\\-\frac12(2-x)^3+\frac32(2-x),&1\le x\le2.\end{cases}$$ Check: $S(0)=0$, $S(1)=1$, $S(2)=0$; at $x=1$ both pieces have $S'=0$ and $S''=-3$; and $S''(0)=S''(2)=0$, so the natural boundary conditions hold. This spline is also the one minimizing $\int_0^2(S'')^2\,dx$ among all $C^2$ functions passing through the three points.

formulas.note: 定义：每段是三次多项式，整体二阶连续可导——比分段线性光滑，比高次多项式稳定。
formulas.noteEn: Definition: a cubic on each piece, globally $C^2$ — smoother than piecewise linear, more stable than a single high-degree polynomial.

formulas.note: 三弯矩方程（内节点）。$M_i=S''(x_i)$；右端 $d_i=\frac{6}{h_{i-1}+h_i}\big[\frac{y_{i+1}-y_i}{h_i}-\frac{y_i-y_{i-1}}{h_{i-1}}\big]$，系数矩阵三对角且严格对角占优。
formulas.noteEn: The three-moment equations at interior nodes, with $M_i=S''(x_i)$ and right-hand side $d_i=\frac{6}{h_{i-1}+h_i}\big[\frac{y_{i+1}-y_i}{h_i}-\frac{y_i-y_{i-1}}{h_{i-1}}\big]$; the matrix is tridiagonal and strictly diagonally dominant.

formulas.note: 三类常用边界条件。补上其中任意一类（两个条件）后，三次样条插值函数存在且唯一。
formulas.noteEn: The three standard boundary conditions; adding any one pair makes the cubic spline interpolant exist and be unique.

formulas.note: 解出三弯矩后计算样条值的分段公式：只用到相邻两个节点上的 $y$ 与 $M$。
formulas.noteEn: The piecewise evaluation formula once the moments are known; it uses only the data and moments at two adjacent nodes.

formulas.note: 误差估计：$O(h^4)$ 的收敛速度远快于分段线性（$O(h^2)$），且不存在龙格式振荡。
formulas.noteEn: Error bound for the clamped spline: $O(h^4)$ convergence, far better than piecewise linear ($O(h^2)$), with no Runge-type oscillation.

properties: 整体二阶连续可导（$C^2$），因此图像光滑、曲率连续，不会像高阶插值那样在端点剧烈振荡。
三类边界（自然、固定、周期）下三次样条插值都存在且唯一；三弯矩方程组三对角且严格对角占优，追赶法 $O(n)$ 求解。
误差：固定边界下 $\max|f-S|\le\frac{5}{384}h^4\max|f^{(4)}|$；自然边界内部也是 $O(h^4)$，但端点附近当 $f''\neq0$ 时可能退化到 $O(h^2)$。
局部性：改变一个数据点只影响附近的少数几段（三对角结构），不像全局多项式那样牵一发而动全身。
自然三次样条具有最小弯曲性质：在所有满足插值条件的 $C^2$ 函数中，它使 $\int_{x_0}^{x_n}(S'')^2\,dx$ 最小，即「曲率能量」最小。
propertiesEn: Globally $C^2$: the curve and its curvature are continuous, with none of the wild endpoint oscillations of high-degree interpolation.

With any of the three boundary types (natural, clamped, periodic) the cubic spline interpolant exists and is unique; the three-moment system is tridiagonal and strictly diagonally dominant, solvable by the Thomas algorithm in $O(n)$.

Error: for clamped boundary conditions $\max|f-S|\le\frac{5}{384}h^4\max|f^{(4)}|$; for the natural spline the interior is still $O(h^4)$, but near the endpoints it may degrade to $O(h^2)$ when $f''\neq0$.
Locality: changing one data point affects only a few neighbouring pieces (tridiagonal structure), unlike a global polynomial where everything moves.
The natural cubic spline has the least-bending property: among all interpolating $C^2$ functions it minimizes $\int_{x_0}^{x_n}(S'')^2\,dx$, the bending energy of the curve.

examples.problem: 用 $[-1,1]$ 上的 11 个等距节点分别做 10 次多项式插值和自然三次样条插值，逼近 $f(x)=\frac{1}{1+25x^2}$，比较误差。
examples.solution: 两种方法都严格穿过全部 11 个节点，但表现完全不同：10 次多项式在 $|x|\approx0.94$ 处冲到约 $1.96$，与 $f$ 的最大偏差约 $1.92$（龙格现象）；自然三次样条的最大偏差仅约 $0.022$，且曲线光滑。同为插值，分段三次加 $C^2$ 光滑性的方案稳定得多。

expression.text: S(x) 分段三次，S ∈ C²[x₀, xₙ]
expression.note: 每段三次、整体二阶连续，这两条决定了样条的形状与光滑性。
expression.noteEn: Cubic on each piece and globally $C^2$: these two requirements shape the spline and guarantee its smoothness.

least-squares-fitting.definition:
实测数据往往带有误差，若像插值那样要求曲线穿过每个数据点，就把噪声也「插」了进去。**最小二乘拟合**改变标准：先选定模型类（例如直线 $\varphi(x)=c_0+c_1x$，或一般的线性组合 $\varphi(x)=\sum_{j=1}^{n}c_j\varphi_j(x)$），再让**残差平方和**
$$Q(c)=\sum_{i=1}^{m}\big(y_i-\varphi(x_i;c)\big)^2$$
最小化；$r_i=y_i-\varphi(x_i;c)$ 称为**残差**。平方的好处是可导、并把正负偏差一起度量；代价是放大了离群点的影响。

对一般（关于系数）线性的模型，把数据写成矩阵形式 $Ac\approx b$，其中 $A_{ij}=\varphi_j(x_i)$ 是 $m\times n$ 矩阵，$b=(y_1,\dots,y_m)^{\top}$，问题就是极小化 $\|Ac-b\|^2$。对每个系数求偏导并令其为零（$\partial Q/\partial c_j=0$），得到**正规方程**
$$A^{\top}A\,c=A^{\top}b.$$
只要 $A$ 列满秩（$n$ 个基函数在数据点上线性无关），$A^{\top}A$ 就对称正定，解存在且唯一；几何上 $Ac$ 是 $b$ 在 $A$ 的列空间上的**正交投影**，残差向量与列空间正交（$A^{\top}(b-Ac)=0$）。

最简单的情形是直线拟合，可直接写出闭式解：
$$c_1=\frac{m\sum x_iy_i-\sum x_i\sum y_i}{m\sum x_i^2-(\sum x_i)^2},\qquad c_0=\bar y-c_1\bar x.$$
最小二乘与插值的区别是本质性的：它不要求过点，用残差平方和（或决定系数 $R^2$）衡量拟合优度；多项式、样条、三角函数等都可充当基函数，而 $\varphi=ae^{bx}$ 这类非线性模型可通过取对数线性化或高斯-牛顿迭代求解。
least-squares-fitting.definitionEn:
Real data carry noise, and forcing a curve through every point (interpolation) also fits the noise. **Least squares fitting** changes the criterion: choose a model class (e.g. a line $\varphi(x)=c_0+c_1x$, or a general linear combination $\varphi(x)=\sum_{j=1}^{n}c_j\varphi_j(x)$) and minimize the **sum of squared residuals**
$$Q(c)=\sum_{i=1}^{m}\big(y_i-\varphi(x_i;c)\big)^2,$$
where $r_i=y_i-\varphi(x_i;c)$ is the **residual**. Squaring makes the objective differentiable and treats positive and negative deviations alike; the price is extra sensitivity to outliers.

For models linear in the coefficients, write the data as $Ac\approx b$ with $A_{ij}=\varphi_j(x_i)$ (an $m\times n$ matrix) and $b=(y_1,\dots,y_m)^{\top}$; the task is to minimize $\|Ac-b\|^2$. Setting all partial derivatives $\partial Q/\partial c_j$ to zero yields the **normal equations**
$$A^{\top}A\,c=A^{\top}b.$$
If $A$ has full column rank (the basis functions are linearly independent on the data points), then $A^{\top}A$ is symmetric positive definite, so the solution exists and is unique; geometrically $Ac$ is the **orthogonal projection** of $b$ onto the column space of $A$, and the residual is orthogonal to that space ($A^{\top}(b-Ac)=0$).

The simplest case is a straight line, with closed-form coefficients:
$$c_1=\frac{m\sum x_iy_i-\sum x_i\sum y_i}{m\sum x_i^2-(\sum x_i)^2},\qquad c_0=\bar y-c_1\bar x.$$
The difference from interpolation is essential: the curve need not pass through the points, and goodness of fit is measured by the residual sum of squares (or the coefficient of determination $R^2$). Polynomials, splines and trigonometric functions can all serve as basis functions, while nonlinear models such as $\varphi=ae^{bx}$ are handled by linearization or Gauss–Newton iteration.
derivation: 设数据 $(x_i,y_i)$（$i=1,\dots,m$）和基函数 $\varphi_1,\dots,\varphi_n$ 给定，模型取线性组合 $\varphi(x;c)=\sum_{j=1}^{n}c_j\varphi_j(x)$。令 $A_{ij}=\varphi_j(x_i)$，$b=(y_1,\dots,y_m)^{\top}$，$c=(c_1,\dots,c_n)^{\top}$，则残差向量为 $r=b-Ac$，最小二乘问题为 $$\begin{aligned}\min_{c\in\mathbb R^n}Q(c)&=\|Ac-b\|_2^2\\&=\sum_{i=1}^{m}\Big(y_i-\sum_{j=1}^{n}A_{ij}c_j\Big)^2.\end{aligned}$$ 这里只假设数据与基函数已给定，不假设 $A$ 满秩（$n\le m$ 只是列满秩的必要条件）。目标函数 $Q\ge0$，最小值总是存在（$\operatorname{col}(A)$ 是闭子空间），但最小值是否唯一取决于 $A$ 的秩。

固定 $A,b$ 后，$Q$ 是 $c$ 的二次多项式：$$Q(c)=c^{\top}A^{\top}Ac-2c^{\top}A^{\top}b+b^{\top}b.$$ 对 $c_k$ 求偏导得 $$\begin{aligned}\frac{\partial Q}{\partial c_k}&=2\sum_{i=1}^{m}A_{ik}\Big(\sum_{j=1}^{n}A_{ij}c_j-y_i\Big)\\&=2\big(A^{\top}Ac-A^{\top}b\big)_k.\end{aligned}$$ 因 $Q$ 在全空间 $\mathbb R^n$ 可微，任何极小点（全空间的内点）都必须使梯度为零。令梯度为零，得到正规方程 $$A^{\top}Ac=A^{\top}b.$$ 这一步只说明极小点必须满足正规方程，尚未说明解存在且唯一。

设 $A$ 列满秩，即 $Av=0$ 只有零解（这要求 $n\le m$）。对任意 $v
e0$，$$v^{	op}A^{	op}Av=\|Av\|_2^2>0,$$ 故 $A^{	op}A$ 对称正定、可逆，正规方程有唯一解 $$c_*=(A^{	op}A)^{-1}A^{	op}b.$$ 又由 $A^{	op}(b-Ac_*)=0$，令 $c=c_*+d$，则 $Ac-b=Ad-r_*$，且交叉项 $-2r_*^{	op}Ad=0$，故 $$Q(c)=Q(c_*)+(c-c_*)^{	op}A^{	op}A(c-c_*),$$ 右端第二项在 $c
e c_*$ 时严格为正，所以 $c_*$ 是全局严格极小点。若 $A$ 列不满秩，正规方程仍有解，因为 $A^{	op}b\in\operatorname{col}(A^{	op})=\operatorname{col}(A^{	op}A)$；但若 $c_0$ 是一个解、$v
e0$ 满足 $Av=0$，则 $c_0+v$ 也是解且残差相同，故解不唯一。此时应取最小范数解或加正则项。

正规方程等价于 $$A^{\top}(b-Ac_*)=0.$$ 因此残差 $r_*=b-Ac_*$ 与 $A$ 的每一列正交。对任意 $u=Av\in\operatorname{col}(A)$，有 $u^{\top}r_*=v^{\top}A^{\top}r_*=0$。于是 $b=Ac_*+r_*$ 是正交分解，$Ac_*=Pb$ 是 $b$ 在 $\operatorname{col}(A)$ 上的正交投影。由勾股定理 $$\|b\|_2^2=\|Ac_*\|_2^2+\|r_*\|_2^2,$$ 最小化残差等价于最大化投影的长度。特别地，若模型含常数项（$A$ 的某列为 $\mathbf 1$），则 $\mathbf 1^{\top}r_*=0$，即残差之和为零。

取基函数 $1,x$，并设 $x_i$ 不全相等。此时 $$\begin{aligned}A^{\top}A&=\begin{pmatrix}m&\sum_i x_i\\ \sum_i x_i&\sum_i x_i^2\end{pmatrix},\\ A^{\top}b&=\begin{pmatrix}\sum_i y_i\\ \sum_i x_iy_i\end{pmatrix}.\end{aligned}$$ 行列式 $D=m\sum_i x_i^2-\big(\sum_i x_i\big)^2=m\sum_i(x_i-\bar x)^2>0$，故矩阵可逆。Cramer 法则给出 $$\begin{aligned}c_1&=\frac{m\sum_i x_iy_i-\sum_i x_i\sum_i y_i}{D},\\ c_0&=\frac{\sum_i y_i\sum_i x_i^2-\sum_i x_i\sum_i x_iy_i}{D}.\end{aligned}$$ 化简第二式得 $c_0=\bar y-c_1\bar x$，即回归直线必过样本中心 $(\bar x,\bar y)$。

理论上可用 $c_*=(A^{\top}A)^{-1}A^{\top}b$，但数值计算不宜显式求逆。若 $A$ 列满秩，则 $A^{\top}A$ 的奇异值是 $A$ 的奇异值的平方，故 $$\kappa_2(A^{\top}A)=\kappa_2(A)^2,$$ 条件数被平方，误差放大因子由 $\kappa_2(A)$ 变为 $\kappa_2(A)^2$，可能使丢失的有效数字位数大约翻倍。改用 Householder QR 分解 $A=QR$，其中 $Q$ 是 $m\times n$ 列正交矩阵、$R$ 是 $n\times n$ 可逆上三角矩阵。则 $$\|Ac-b\|_2^2=\|Rc-Q^{\top}b\|_2^2+\|(I-QQ^{\top})b\|_2^2,$$ 第二项与 $c$ 无关，最小化只需解上三角方程 $Rc=Q^{\top}b$ 并回代，既不形成 $A^{\top}A$ 也不求逆。若 $A$ 秩亏，则用 SVD（或完全正交分解）求最小范数解；带列主元的 QR 可用于判定数值秩和稳定求解。
derivationEn: Let data $(x_i,y_i)$ ($i=1,\dots,m$) and basis functions $\varphi_1,\dots,\varphi_n$ be given, and take the model $\varphi(x;c)=\sum_{j=1}^{n}c_j\varphi_j(x)$. Set $A_{ij}=\varphi_j(x_i)$, $b=(y_1,\dots,y_m)^{\top}$ and $c=(c_1,\dots,c_n)^{\top}$. The residual vector is $r=b-Ac$, and the least squares problem is $$\begin{aligned}\min_{c\in\mathbb R^n}Q(c)&=\|Ac-b\|_2^2\\&=\sum_{i=1}^{m}\Big(y_i-\sum_{j=1}^{n}A_{ij}c_j\Big)^2.\end{aligned}$$ We assume only that the data and basis functions are given; $A$ is not assumed to have full rank ($n\le m$ is merely necessary for full column rank). The objective satisfies $Q\ge0$; a minimizer always exists because $\operatorname{col}(A)$ is a closed subspace, but its uniqueness depends on the rank of $A$.

Once $A$ and $b$ are fixed, $Q$ is a quadratic polynomial in $c$: $$Q(c)=c^{\top}A^{\top}Ac-2c^{\top}A^{\top}b+b^{\top}b.$$ Differentiating with respect to $c_k$ gives $$\begin{aligned}\frac{\partial Q}{\partial c_k}&=2\sum_{i=1}^{m}A_{ik}\Big(\sum_{j=1}^{n}A_{ij}c_j-y_i\Big)\\&=2\big(A^{\top}Ac-A^{\top}b\big)_k.\end{aligned}$$ Since $Q$ is differentiable on all of $\mathbb R^n$, every minimizer (an interior point of the whole space) must have zero gradient. Setting the gradient to zero gives the normal equations $$A^{\top}Ac=A^{\top}b.$$ This step only shows that any minimizer must satisfy them; existence and uniqueness are not yet established.

Assume $A$ has full column rank, that is, $Av=0$ only for $v=0$ (this requires $n\le m$). For every $v
e0$, $$v^{	op}A^{	op}Av=\|Av\|_2^2>0,$$ so $A^{	op}A$ is symmetric positive definite and invertible, and the normal equations have the unique solution $$c_*=(A^{	op}A)^{-1}A^{	op}b.$$ Moreover, $A^{	op}(b-Ac_*)=0$. Writing $c=c_*+d$ gives $Ac-b=Ad-r_*$, and the cross term $-2r_*^{	op}Ad$ vanishes, so $$Q(c)=Q(c_*)+(c-c_*)^{	op}A^{	op}A(c-c_*),$$ and the second term on the right is strictly positive whenever $c
e c_*$. Hence $c_*$ is the unique global minimizer. If $A$ is rank deficient, the normal equations are still consistent, since $A^{	op}b\in\operatorname{col}(A^{	op})=\operatorname{col}(A^{	op}A)$. But if $c_0$ is one solution and $v
e0$ satisfies $Av=0$, then $c_0+v$ is also a solution with the same residual, so the solution is not unique. One then takes the minimum-norm solution or adds a regularization term.

The normal equations are equivalent to $$A^{\top}(b-Ac_*)=0.$$ Therefore the residual $r_*=b-Ac_*$ is orthogonal to every column of $A$. For any $u=Av\in\operatorname{col}(A)$, $$u^{\top}r_*=v^{\top}A^{\top}r_*=0.$$ Thus $b=Ac_*+r_*$ is an orthogonal decomposition, and $Ac_*=Pb$ is the orthogonal projection of $b$ onto $\operatorname{col}(A)$. Pythagoras' theorem gives $$\|b\|_2^2=\|Ac_*\|_2^2+\|r_*\|_2^2,$$ so minimizing the residual is equivalent to maximizing the length of the projection. In particular, if the model contains an intercept (one column of $A$ is $\mathbf 1$), then $\mathbf 1^{\top}r_*=0$, i.e. the residuals sum to zero.

Take the basis functions $1,x$ and suppose the $x_i$ are not all equal. Then $$\begin{aligned}A^{\top}A&=\begin{pmatrix}m&\sum_i x_i\\ \sum_i x_i&\sum_i x_i^2\end{pmatrix},\\ A^{\top}b&=\begin{pmatrix}\sum_i y_i\\ \sum_i x_iy_i\end{pmatrix}.\end{aligned}$$ Its determinant is $D=m\sum_i x_i^2-\big(\sum_i x_i\big)^2=m\sum_i(x_i-\bar x)^2>0$, so the matrix is invertible. Cramer's rule gives $$\begin{aligned}c_1&=\frac{m\sum_i x_iy_i-\sum_i x_i\sum_i y_i}{D},\\ c_0&=\frac{\sum_i y_i\sum_i x_i^2-\sum_i x_i\sum_i x_iy_i}{D}.\end{aligned}$$ Simplifying the second expression yields $c_0=\bar y-c_1\bar x$, so the regression line passes through the sample mean $(\bar x,\bar y)$.

In theory one can use $c_*=(A^{\top}A)^{-1}A^{\top}b$, but explicit inversion is inappropriate in numerical computation. If $A$ has full column rank, the singular values of $A^{\top}A$ are the squares of those of $A$, hence $$\kappa_2(A^{\top}A)=\kappa_2(A)^2,$$ so the condition number is squared: the error amplification factor changes from $\kappa_2(A)$ to $\kappa_2(A)^2$, and the number of digits lost may roughly double. Instead, use a Householder QR factorization $A=QR$, where $Q$ is $m\times n$ with orthonormal columns and $R$ is $n\times n$, upper triangular and invertible. Then $$\|Ac-b\|_2^2=\|Rc-Q^{\top}b\|_2^2+\|(I-QQ^{\top})b\|_2^2,$$ and the second term is independent of $c$. The minimization therefore reduces to solving the upper triangular system $Rc=Q^{\top}b$ by back substitution, without forming $A^{\top}A$ or inverting a matrix. If $A$ is rank deficient, use the SVD (or a complete orthogonal decomposition) to obtain the minimum-norm solution; column-pivoted QR is useful for determining the numerical rank and for stable solving.

formulas.note: 最小二乘准则：让残差（竖直偏差）平方和最小；不要求曲线穿过数据点。
formulas.noteEn: The least squares criterion: minimize the sum of squared vertical residuals; the curve need not pass through the data points.

formulas.note: 一般线性模型与矩阵写法：$\varphi_j$ 是任意选定的基函数（$1,x,x^2,\dots$）。
formulas.noteEn: A general linear model in matrix form, where $\varphi_j$ are chosen basis functions ($1,x,x^2,\dots$).

formulas.note: 正规方程：由 $\partial Q/\partial c_j=0$ 得到。$A$ 列满秩时 $A^{\top}A$ 对称正定，解唯一；几何上 $Ac$ 是 $b$ 在 $A$ 列空间上的正交投影。
formulas.noteEn: The normal equations, from $\partial Q/\partial c_j=0$. If $A$ has full column rank, $A^{\top}A$ is symmetric positive definite and the solution is unique; $Ac$ is the orthogonal projection of $b$ onto the column space.

formulas.latex: c_1=\frac{m\sum x_iy_i-\sum x_i\sum y_i}{m\sum x_i^2-(\sum x_i)^2},\qquad c_0=\bar y-c_1\bar x
formulas.note: 直线拟合的闭式解：回归直线过样本中心 $(\bar x,\bar y)$，斜率由协方差与方差之比给出。
formulas.noteEn: Closed form for a straight line: the regression line passes through $(\bar x,\bar y)$, and the slope is the ratio of covariance to variance.

formulas.note: 决定系数：模型解释的数据变差比例，越接近 1 线性拟合越好（但不代表模型本身一定合理）。
formulas.noteEn: Coefficient of determination: the fraction of data variation explained by the model; closer to 1 means a better fit, though not automatically a sensible model.

properties: 正规方程的几何解释：残差向量 $b-Ac$ 与 $A$ 的每一列正交（$A^{\top}(b-Ac)=0$），$Ac$ 是 $b$ 在列空间上的正交投影。
唯一性：$A$ 列满秩时 $A^{\top}A$ 对称正定，拟合系数存在且唯一；若列相关（如重复基函数）则解不唯一。
与插值对比：拟合不穿过全部点，用平方和衡量整体偏差，能平滑掉噪声——点少模型强时会更稳。
对离群值敏感：平方损失放大大误差的权重；必要时改用加权最小二乘或稳健回归。
数值上正规方程会把条件数平方（$\kappa(A^{\top}A)=\kappa(A)^2$），病态数据宜用 QR 分解或 SVD 求解。
propertiesEn: Geometry: the residual $b-Ac$ is orthogonal to every column of $A$ ($A^{\top}(b-Ac)=0$), so $Ac$ is the orthogonal projection of $b$ onto the column space.
Uniqueness: with full column rank, $A^{\top}A$ is symmetric positive definite and the fitted coefficients are unique; dependent columns make the solution non-unique.
Unlike interpolation, the curve misses the points on purpose, balancing overall squared error and smoothing noise.
Sensitivity to outliers: the squared loss over-weights large residuals; weighted or robust least squares are the remedy.
Numerically, normal equations square the condition number ($\kappa(A^{\top}A)=\kappa(A)^2$); ill-conditioned problems are better solved by QR or SVD.

examples.solution:
$m=3$，$\sum x_i=6$，$\sum y_i=7$，$\sum x_iy_i=1+4+12=17$，$\sum x_i^2=1+4+9=14$。代入公式
$$c_1=\frac{3\cdot17-6\cdot7}{3\cdot14-6^2}=\frac{9}{6}=1.5,\qquad c_0=\frac73-1.5\cdot2=-\frac23,$$
所以 $y=1.5x-\frac23$。三个残差为 $\frac16,-\frac13,\frac16$，平方和 $Q=\frac16$，比任何其它直线都小。

expression.note: 记住正规方程就记住了线性最小二乘的一切：构造 $A$、解 $2\times2$ 或 $n\times n$ 的对称正定方程组。
expression.noteEn: The normal equations capture all of linear least squares: build $A$, then solve a symmetric positive-definite system.

numerical-differentiation.definition:
当函数只以表格形式给出、或者解析式太复杂时，可以用函数值的**差商**近似导数。起点是导数定义
$$f'(x)=\lim_{h\to0}\frac{f(x+h)-f(x)}{h}.$$
最直接的是**前向差商** $\dfrac{f(x+h)-f(x)}{h}$。由泰勒展开 $f(x+h)=f(x)+hf'(x)+\dfrac{h^2}{2}f''(\xi)$ 知，它等于 $f'(x)$ 加上约 $\dfrac{h}{2}f''(x)$ 的误差，即**截断误差为 $O(h)$**；**后向差商** $\dfrac{f(x)-f(x-h)}{h}$ 完全对称，误差也是 $O(h)$。

把泰勒展开写成两个方向再相减，偶次项全部抵消：
$$f(x+h)-f(x-h)=2hf'(x)+\frac{h^3}{3}f'''(\xi),$$
于是**中心差商**
$$\frac{f(x+h)-f(x-h)}{2h}=f'(x)+\frac{h^2}{6}f'''(\xi)$$
只有 $O(h^2)$ 的截断误差——用同样多的函数值，精度提高一阶，所以实用中优先用中心差商。**二阶导数**也有中心公式 $\dfrac{f(x+h)-2f(x)+f(x-h)}{h^2}=f''(x)+O(h^2)$。

数值微分有一个独特困难：**不稳定**。实际误差由两部分组成：截断误差约 $M h^2/6$（以中心差商为例，$M\approx|f'''|$）和舍入误差——两点函数值相减会产生抵消，误差约为机器精度 $\varepsilon$，再被除以 $h$，故舍入部分约 $\varepsilon/h$。二者之和在
$$h_*\approx\Big(\frac{3\varepsilon}{M}\Big)^{1/3}$$
处最小。对双精度（$\varepsilon\approx2.2\times10^{-16}$）和 $f=\sin$ 在 $x=1$ 处，$h_*$ 约 $10^{-5}$：$h$ 取得更小，结果反而越来越差。这和数值积分不同——积分是平滑算子的近似，而微分是「病态」放大算子的近似。
numerical-differentiation.definitionEn:
When a function is known only through a table of values, or its formula is too complicated, derivatives are approximated by **difference quotients** starting from the definition
$$f'(x)=\lim_{h\to0}\frac{f(x+h)-f(x)}{h}.$$
The **forward difference** $\dfrac{f(x+h)-f(x)}{h}$ has, by Taylor expansion $f(x+h)=f(x)+hf'(x)+\dfrac{h^2}{2}f''(\xi)$, an error of about $\dfrac{h}{2}f''(x)$ — that is, **truncation error $O(h)$**; the **backward difference** $\dfrac{f(x)-f(x-h)}{h}$ is symmetric and also $O(h)$.

Subtracting the two Taylor expansions cancels all even-order terms:
$$f(x+h)-f(x-h)=2hf'(x)+\frac{h^3}{3}f'''(\xi),$$
so the **central difference**
$$\frac{f(x+h)-f(x-h)}{2h}=f'(x)+\frac{h^2}{6}f'''(\xi)$$
has truncation error only $O(h^2)$ — one order better for the same amount of work, which is why the central difference is preferred. The **second derivative** has the central formula $\dfrac{f(x+h)-2f(x)+f(x-h)}{h^2}=f''(x)+O(h^2)$.

Numerical differentiation has a distinctive difficulty: **instability**. The total error has two parts: truncation about $M h^2/6$ (for the central difference, $M\approx|f'''|$) and rounding — subtracting two nearby function values loses digits, contributing about the machine epsilon $\varepsilon$ divided by $h$, i.e. $\varepsilon/h$. Their sum is minimized at
$$h_*\approx\Big(\frac{3\varepsilon}{M}\Big)^{1/3}.$$
In double precision ($\varepsilon\approx2.2\times10^{-16}$) for $f=\sin$ at $x=1$, $h_*$ is about $10^{-5}$: making $h$ smaller than that only makes the answer worse. Unlike numerical integration, numerical differentiation approximates an ill-posed amplifying operator.
derivation: 设 $f\in C^2$ 在以 $x$ 与 $x+h$ 为端点的闭区间上，$h\ne0$。带 Lagrange 余项的 Taylor 公式给出 $$f(x+h)=f(x)+hf'(x)+\frac{h^2}{2}f''(\xi_+),$$ 其中 $\xi_+$ 介于 $x$ 与 $x+h$ 之间。移项并除以 $h$：$$D_+(h)=\frac{f(x+h)-f(x)}{h}=f'(x)+\frac{h}{2}f''(\xi_+).$$ 故前向差商的截断误差为 $O(h)$；若 $|f''|\le M$，则 $|D_+(h)-f'(x)|\le M|h|/2$。同理，后向差商满足 $$D_-(h)=\frac{f(x)-f(x-h)}{h}=f'(x)-\frac{h}{2}f''(\xi_-),$$ 误差同样是 $O(h)$。

设 $f\in C^3$。把 $x+h$ 与 $x-h$ 处的 Taylor 展开写到三阶：$$f(x+h)=f+hf'+\frac{h^2}{2}f''+\frac{h^3}{6}f'''(\xi_+),$$ $$f(x-h)=f-hf'+\frac{h^2}{2}f''-\frac{h^3}{6}f'''(\xi_-).$$ 两式相减，偶次项抵消：$$f(x+h)-f(x-h)=2hf'+\frac{h^3}{6}\big[f'''(\xi_+)+f'''(\xi_-)\big].$$ 因 $f'''$ 连续，由介值定理存在 $\xi$ 使方括号等于 $2f'''(\xi)$。除以 $2h$ 得 $$D_c(h)=\frac{f(x+h)-f(x-h)}{2h}=f'(x)+\frac{h^2}{6}f'''(\xi).$$ 因此中心差商的截断误差为 $O(h^2)$，比单侧差商高一阶；代价是要求 $f\in C^3$ 且 $x\pm h$ 都在定义域内。

设 $f\in C^4$。把上述两式相加，奇次项抵消：$$f(x+h)+f(x-h)=2f(x)+h^2f''(x)+\frac{h^4}{24}\big[f^{(4)}(\eta_+)+f^{(4)}(\eta_-)\big].$$ 由 $f^{(4)}$ 的连续性并用介值定理，存在 $\eta$ 使方括号等于 $2f^{(4)}(\eta)$。于是 $$D_2(h)=\frac{f(x+h)-2f(x)+f(x-h)}{h^2}=f''(x)+\frac{h^2}{12}f^{(4)}(\eta).$$ 故二阶中心差商也是 $O(h^2)$，但它需要四阶光滑性；它也可看作对步长 $h/2$ 的两个一阶中心差商再作一次差商。

实际计算只能得到带舍入误差的函数值 $\hat f(x\pm h)=f(x\pm h)(1+\delta_\pm)$，$|\delta_\pm|\le u$，其中 $u$ 是机器精度（双精度约 $2.2\times10^{-16}$）。中心差商的总误差由截断项 $\frac{h^2}{6}f'''(\xi)$ 与舍入项 $$\frac{[\hat f(x+h)-f(x+h)]-[\hat f(x-h)-f(x-h)]}{2h}$$ 组成；后者绝对值不超过约 $u|f|/h$，更一般地记为 $\varepsilon/h$，其中 $\varepsilon$ 是函数值的绝对误差水平。因此总误差模型为 $$E(h)\approx\frac{Mh^2}{6}+\frac{\varepsilon}{h},\qquad M=\max|f'''|.$$ 求导得 $E'(h)=\frac{Mh}{3}-\frac{\varepsilon}{h^2}$，令其为零得 $$h_*=\Big(\frac{3\varepsilon}{M}\Big)^{1/3},$$ 且 $E''(h)=M/3+2\varepsilon/h^3>0$，故这是极小点。结论：$h$ 并非越小越好；舍入误差随 $h$ 减小按 $1/h$ 增大，双精度下 $M\sim1$ 时 $h_*\sim10^{-5}$。

设 $h>0$。中心公式要求 $x-h$ 与 $x+h$ 都在定义域内，因此在端点只能用单侧公式。在左端点 $a$ 用 $f(a),f(a+h),f(a+2h)$（要求 $a+2h\le b$）作二次插值并求导，得到 $$\begin{aligned}D_+^{(2)}(a)&=\frac{-3f(a)+4f(a+h)-f(a+2h)}{2h}\\&=f'(a)-\frac{h^2}{3}f'''(\xi),\end{aligned}$$ 其中 $\xi\in(a,a+2h)$，故仍是 $O(h^2)$。在右端点 $b$ 同理，用 $f(b),f(b-h),f(b-2h)$（要求 $b-2h\ge a$）：$$D_-^{(2)}(b)=\frac{3f(b)-4f(b-h)+f(b-2h)}{2h}=f'(b)-\frac{h^2}{3}f'''(\eta),$$ 其中 $\eta\in(b-2h,b)$。若在端点强行使用中心公式，就会用到定义域外的函数值；若改用一阶单侧差商，精度则降为 $O(h)$。

若 $f\in C^5$，中心差商有展开 $$\begin{aligned}D(h)&=f'(x)+c_2h^2+c_4h^4+o(h^4),\\ c_2&=\frac{f'''(x)}{6},\qquad c_4=\frac{f^{(5)}(x)}{120}.\end{aligned}$$ 于是 $$D(h/2)=f'(x)+\frac{c_2h^2}{4}+\frac{c_4h^4}{16}+o(h^4).$$ 用组合 $\frac{4D(h/2)-D(h)}{3}$ 消去 $h^2$ 项：$$\frac{4D(h/2)-D(h)}{3}=f'(x)-\frac{c_4h^4}{4}+o(h^4)=f'(x)+O(h^4).$$ 这就是 Richardson 外推。条件是 $f$ 足够光滑（$C^5$ 已能保证 $O(h^4)$ 余项）；它不能消除舍入误差，组合后的舍入仍约为 $\varepsilon/h$，所以外推并不能让最优步长无限变小。
derivationEn: Let $f\in C^2$ on the closed interval with endpoints $x$ and $x+h$, $h\ne0$. Taylor's formula with Lagrange remainder gives $$f(x+h)=f(x)+hf'(x)+\frac{h^2}{2}f''(\xi_+),$$ where $\xi_+$ lies between $x$ and $x+h$. Rearranging and dividing by $h$ gives $$D_+(h)=\frac{f(x+h)-f(x)}{h}=f'(x)+\frac{h}{2}f''(\xi_+).$$ Hence the forward difference has truncation error $O(h)$; if $|f''|\le M$, then $|D_+(h)-f'(x)|\le M|h|/2$. Similarly, the backward difference satisfies $$D_-(h)=\frac{f(x)-f(x-h)}{h}=f'(x)-\frac{h}{2}f''(\xi_-),$$ and is also $O(h)$.

Let $f\in C^3$. Expand at $x+h$ and $x-h$ through third order: $$f(x+h)=f+hf'+\frac{h^2}{2}f''+\frac{h^3}{6}f'''(\xi_+),$$ $$f(x-h)=f-hf'+\frac{h^2}{2}f''-\frac{h^3}{6}f'''(\xi_-).$$ Subtracting cancels the even-order terms: $$f(x+h)-f(x-h)=2hf'+\frac{h^3}{6}\big[f'''(\xi_+)+f'''(\xi_-)\big].$$ Since $f'''$ is continuous, the intermediate value theorem gives some $\xi$ for which the bracket equals $2f'''(\xi)$. Dividing by $2h$ yields $$D_c(h)=\frac{f(x+h)-f(x-h)}{2h}=f'(x)+\frac{h^2}{6}f'''(\xi).$$ Therefore the central difference has truncation error $O(h^2)$, one order better than the one-sided formulas; the price is the hypothesis $f\in C^3$ and the need for $x\pm h$ to lie in the domain.

Let $f\in C^4$. Adding the two expansions cancels the odd-order terms: $$f(x+h)+f(x-h)=2f(x)+h^2f''(x)+\frac{h^4}{24}\big[f^{(4)}(\eta_+)+f^{(4)}(\eta_-)\big].$$ By continuity of $f^{(4)}$ and the intermediate value theorem, some $\eta$ makes the bracket equal $2f^{(4)}(\eta)$. Hence $$D_2(h)=\frac{f(x+h)-2f(x)+f(x-h)}{h^2}=f''(x)+\frac{h^2}{12}f^{(4)}(\eta).$$ Thus the central second difference is also $O(h^2)$, but it requires fourth-order smoothness; it can also be viewed as one more difference quotient applied to two first central differences with step $h/2$.

In actual computation one obtains only function values with rounding error $\hat f(x\pm h)=f(x\pm h)(1+\delta_\pm)$, $|\delta_\pm|\le u$, where $u$ is the machine precision (about $2.2\times10^{-16}$ in double precision). The total error of the central difference consists of the truncation term $\frac{h^2}{6}f'''(\xi)$ and the rounding term $$\frac{[\hat f(x+h)-f(x+h)]-[\hat f(x-h)-f(x-h)]}{2h},$$ whose magnitude is at most about $u|f|/h$, or more generally $\varepsilon/h$, where $\varepsilon$ is the absolute error level of the function values. Hence the total error model is $$E(h)\approx\frac{Mh^2}{6}+\frac{\varepsilon}{h},\qquad M=\max|f'''|.$$ Differentiating gives $E'(h)=\frac{Mh}{3}-\frac{\varepsilon}{h^2}$; setting it to zero yields $$h_*=\Big(\frac{3\varepsilon}{M}\Big)^{1/3},$$ and $E''(h)=M/3+2\varepsilon/h^3>0$, so this is a minimum. Conclusion: $h$ is not the smaller the better; the rounding error grows like $1/h$ as $h$ decreases, and in double precision with $M\sim1$, $h_*\sim10^{-5}$.

Assume $h>0$. The central formula requires both $x-h$ and $x+h$ to lie in the domain, so at endpoints one must use one-sided formulas. At the left endpoint $a$, provided $a+2h\le b$, interpolate $f(a),f(a+h),f(a+2h)$ by a quadratic and differentiate: $$\begin{aligned}D_+^{(2)}(a)&=\frac{-3f(a)+4f(a+h)-f(a+2h)}{2h}\\&=f'(a)-\frac{h^2}{3}f'''(\xi),\end{aligned}$$ where $\xi\in(a,a+2h)$; the error is still $O(h^2)$. At the right endpoint $b$, provided $b-2h\ge a$, similarly, using $f(b),f(b-h),f(b-2h)$: $$D_-^{(2)}(b)=\frac{3f(b)-4f(b-h)+f(b-2h)}{2h}=f'(b)-\frac{h^2}{3}f'''(\eta),$$ where $\eta\in(b-2h,b)$. If one insists on the central formula at an endpoint, values outside the domain are needed; if one uses a first-order one-sided difference instead, the accuracy drops to $O(h)$.

If $f\in C^5$, the central difference has the expansion $$\begin{aligned}D(h)&=f'(x)+c_2h^2+c_4h^4+o(h^4),\\ c_2&=\frac{f'''(x)}{6},\qquad c_4=\frac{f^{(5)}(x)}{120}.\end{aligned}$$ Thus $$D(h/2)=f'(x)+\frac{c_2h^2}{4}+\frac{c_4h^4}{16}+o(h^4).$$ The combination $\frac{4D(h/2)-D(h)}{3}$ cancels the $h^2$ term: $$\frac{4D(h/2)-D(h)}{3}=f'(x)-\frac{c_4h^4}{4}+o(h^4)=f'(x)+O(h^4).$$ This is Richardson extrapolation. The hypothesis is sufficient smoothness ($C^5$ already ensures an $O(h^4)$ remainder); it cannot remove rounding error, since the combined rounding remains of order $\varepsilon/h$, so extrapolation does not allow the optimal step to become arbitrarily small.

formulas.note: 前向差商：截断误差 $O(h)$；后向差商 $\frac{f(x)-f(x-h)}{h}$ 误差同样是一阶。
formulas.noteEn: Forward difference with $O(h)$ truncation error; the backward difference $\frac{f(x)-f(x-h)}{h}$ is equally first order.

formulas.note: 中心差商：两个方向展开相减使偶次项抵消，截断误差跳到二阶，是数值微分的首选公式。
formulas.noteEn: Central difference: subtracting the two expansions cancels even-order terms and raises the truncation error to second order — the workhorse formula.

formulas.note: 二阶导数的中心公式：误差 $O(h^2)$；也可看作对一阶中心差商再做一次差商。
formulas.noteEn: Central formula for the second derivative with $O(h^2)$ error; it can also be seen as a difference quotient of central differences.

formulas.note: 中心差商的总误差模型：截断与舍入的折中。双精度下最优步长约 $10^{-5}$ 量级，$h$ 再小舍入误差就占主导。
formulas.noteEn: Total error model for the central difference: a trade-off between truncation and rounding. In double precision the optimal step is about $10^{-5}$; smaller steps are dominated by rounding.

formulas.note: Richardson 外推：用两个步长的中心差商组合，把 $O(h^2)$ 误差项消去，得到四阶精度。
formulas.noteEn: Richardson extrapolation: combining central differences at two step sizes cancels the $O(h^2)$ term and gives fourth-order accuracy.

properties: 精度阶梯：前向/后向差商 $O(h)$，中心差商 $O(h^2)$，二阶导数中心公式也是 $O(h^2)$；Richardson 外推可到 $O(h^4)$。
中心差商需要节点关于 $x$ 对称；区间端点处没有两侧函数值，只能用单侧（前向或后向）公式。
不稳定：总误差约 $Mh^2/6+\varepsilon/h$，存在最优步长 $h_*\approx(3\varepsilon/M)^{1/3}$，$h$ 过小结果反而变坏。
与插值的关系：用插值多项式的导数可以构造任意求导公式；但高次插值的导数误差可能很大，实用的公式都只用少数几个邻近节点。
应用广泛：为微分方程的离散格式（Euler 法、有限差分）提供基础，也用于估计数值积分误差项中的 $f''$。
propertiesEn: Accuracy ladder: forward/backward $O(h)$, central $O(h^2)$, central second derivative also $O(h^2)$; Richardson extrapolation reaches $O(h^4)$.
The central formula needs nodes symmetric about $x$; at interval endpoints only one-sided (forward or backward) formulas are available.
Instability: the total error is about $Mh^2/6+\varepsilon/h$ with an optimal step $h_*\approx(3\varepsilon/M)^{1/3}$; taking $h$ too small makes things worse.

Connection with interpolation: differentiating an interpolant yields derivative formulas of any order, but high-degree interpolation gives poor derivatives, so practical formulas use only a few nearby nodes.
Widely used: it underlies finite differences for ODEs (Euler's method, finite-difference schemes) and supplies the $f''$ term in quadrature error estimates.

examples.problem: 取 $h=0.1$，用前向、后向、中心差商分别近似 $f'(2)$，$f(x)=\ln x$。
用中心差商近似 $f'(1)$，$f(x)=\sin x$（真值 $\cos1\approx0.5403023$），观察误差随 $h$ 的变化。

expression.note: 中心差商是最常用的数值微分公式；节点对称、精度二阶、实现简单。
expression.noteEn: The central difference is the standard numerical derivative formula: symmetric nodes, second-order accuracy, trivial to implement.

numerical-integration.definition:
当原函数求不出来、或被积函数只以表格形式给出时，可以用**节点函数值的加权和**近似定积分：
$$\int_a^b f(x)\,dx\approx\sum_{i}w_i f(x_i),$$
这类式子称为**求积公式**。最简单的想法是用 $f(a)$、$f(b)$ 两点连线（一次插值）代替 $f$ 再积分，得到**梯形公式**
$$T=\frac{b-a}{2}\big[f(a)+f(b)\big],$$
几何上就是以 $f(a)$、$f(b)$ 为上下底的梯形面积。把 $[a,b]$ 等分成 $n$ 段（$h=(b-a)/n$）逐段用梯形公式再求和，得到**复化梯形公式**
$$T_n=\frac{h}{2}\Big[f(a)+2\sum_{i=1}^{n-1}f(x_i)+f(b)\Big].$$

**辛普森公式**提高一档：每两个子区间用通过三个点 $(x_{2k},f_{2k})$、$(x_{2k+1},f_{2k+1})$、$(x_{2k+2},f_{2k+2})$ 的**抛物线**代替 $f$，对抛物线积分得 $\frac{h}{3}(f_{2k}+4f_{2k+1}+f_{2k+2})$；逐片累加得到复化辛普森公式
$$S_n=\frac{h}{3}\Big[f(a)+4\!\!\sum_{i\ \text{奇数}}\!\!f(x_i)+2\!\!\sum_{i\ \text{偶数}}\!\!f(x_i)+f(b)\Big]\qquad(n\ \text{为偶数}).$$

误差方面，若 $f$ 足够光滑，复化梯形的余项为 $R_T=-\dfrac{(b-a)h^2}{12}f''(\xi)=-\dfrac{(b-a)^3}{12n^2}f''(\xi)$，复化辛普森的余项为 $R_S=-\dfrac{(b-a)h^4}{180}f^{(4)}(\xi)$。这说明 $n$ 加倍时梯形误差约缩小 4 倍、辛普森约缩小 16 倍。

还有一个更细的尺度是**代数精度**（对次数不超过 $k$ 的多项式都精确、对 $k+1$ 次不精确的最大 $k$）：梯形公式的代数精度为 1（$\int_a^b x\,dx$ 精确，$\int_a^b x^2\,dx$ 不精确），而辛普森公式达到 3——虽然它只是二次插值的积分，却由于节点的对称性对三次多项式也精确。
numerical-integration.definitionEn:
When an antiderivative is unavailable, or the integrand is known only from a table, a definite integral is approximated by a **weighted sum of function values**:
$$\int_a^b f(x)\,dx\approx\sum_{i}w_i f(x_i).$$
Such expressions are called **quadrature rules**. The simplest idea replaces $f$ by the straight line through $(a,f(a))$ and $(b,f(b))$ and integrates it, giving the **trapezoidal rule**
$$T=\frac{b-a}{2}\big[f(a)+f(b)\big],$$
the area of the trapezoid with parallel sides $f(a)$ and $f(b)$. Splitting $[a,b]$ into $n$ equal parts ($h=(b-a)/n$) and summing the trapezoids yields the **composite trapezoidal rule**
$$T_n=\frac{h}{2}\Big[f(a)+2\sum_{i=1}^{n-1}f(x_i)+f(b)\Big].$$

**Simpson's rule** goes one level higher: on every pair of subintervals replace $f$ by the **parabola** through $(x_{2k},f_{2k})$, $(x_{2k+1},f_{2k+1})$, $(x_{2k+2},f_{2k+2})$ and integrate it to get $\frac{h}{3}(f_{2k}+4f_{2k+1}+f_{2k+2})$; summing over pairs gives the composite rule
$$S_n=\frac{h}{3}\Big[f(a)+4\!\!\sum_{i\ \text{odd}}\!\!f(x_i)+2\!\!\sum_{i\ \text{even}}\!\!f(x_i)+f(b)\Big]\qquad(n\ \text{even}).$$

For sufficiently smooth $f$, the composite trapezoidal remainder is $R_T=-\dfrac{(b-a)h^2}{12}f''(\xi)=-\dfrac{(b-a)^3}{12n^2}f''(\xi)$, while Simpson's remainder is $R_S=-\dfrac{(b-a)h^4}{180}f^{(4)}(\xi)$. Doubling $n$ therefore cuts the trapezoidal error by about 4 and Simpson's error by about 16.

A finer measure of accuracy is the **degree of precision** (the largest $k$ such that all polynomials of degree $\le k$ are integrated exactly): it is 1 for the trapezoidal rule ($\int_a^b x\,dx$ is exact, $\int_a^b x^2\,dx$ is not) and 3 for Simpson's rule — even though Simpson's rule comes from integrating a quadratic interpolant, the symmetry of the nodes makes cubics exact as well.
derivation: 设 $f\in C^2[a,b]$，在 $[a,b]$ 上取线性插值 $$p_1(x)=f(a)\frac{b-x}{b-a}+f(b)\frac{x-a}{b-a}.$$ 插值余项为 $$f(x)-p_1(x)=\frac{f''(\xi_x)}{2}(x-a)(x-b).$$ 因为 $(x-a)(x-b)\le0$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上不变号，且 $f''$ 连续，积分后用加权中值定理：$$\begin{aligned}\int_a^b f(x)\,dx-\int_a^b p_1(x)\,dx&=\frac12\int_a^b f''(\xi_x)(x-a)(x-b)\,dx\\&=-\frac{(b-a)^3}{12}f''(\xi).\end{aligned}$$ 而 $\int_a^b p_1(x)\,dx=\frac{b-a}{2}[f(a)+f(b)]=T$。故梯形公式的余项（真值减近似）为 $$I-T=-\frac{(b-a)^3}{12}f''(\xi).$$ 当 $f''>0$ 时 $I-T<0$，即梯形公式高估积分。

把 $[a,b]$ 等分为 $n$ 段，$h=(b-a)/n$，$x_i=a+ih$，则 $$T_n=\frac{h}{2}\Big[f(a)+2\sum_{i=1}^{n-1}f(x_i)+f(b)\Big].$$ 对每段 $[x_{i-1},x_i]$ 用第 1 步，得 $I_i-T_i=-\frac{h^3}{12}f''(\xi_i)$。相加得 $$I-T_n=-\frac{h^3}{12}\sum_{i=1}^{n}f''(\xi_i)=-\frac{nh^3}{12}f''(\xi),$$ 最后一步用 $f''$ 的连续性与加权中值定理（各系数同号）。由 $nh=b-a$，$$I-T_n=-\frac{(b-a)h^2}{12}f''(\xi)=-\frac{(b-a)^3}{12n^2}f''(\xi).$$ 故复化梯形误差为 $O(h^2)$；$n$ 加倍时误差约变为原来的 $1/4$。

设 $n$ 为偶数，$h=(b-a)/n$，把 $[a,b]$ 分成 $n/2$ 个长度为 $2h$ 的片。逐片用第 3 步的公式并求和，得 $$S_n=\frac{h}{3}\Big[f(a)+4\sum_{i\ \text{odd}}f(x_i)+2\sum_{i\ \text{even}}f(x_i)+f(b)\Big],$$ 其中 $i=1,\dots,n-1$。每片的误差为 $I_k-S_k=-\frac{h^5}{90}f^{(4)}(\xi_k)$。由 $f^{(4)}$ 的连续性与加权中值定理，相加得 $$\begin{aligned}I-S_n&=-\frac{h^5}{90}\sum_{k=1}^{n/2}f^{(4)}(\xi_k)\\&=-\frac{(n/2)h^5}{90}f^{(4)}(\xi)\\&=-\frac{(b-a)h^4}{180}f^{(4)}(\xi).\end{aligned}$$ 故复化 Simpson 的余项为 $O(h^4)$，$n$ 加倍时误差约降为原来的 $1/16$。$n$ 必须为偶数，因为每片抛物线覆盖两个子区间；$f\in C^4$ 是误差公式的前提。

代数精度定义为对所有次数不超过 $k$ 的多项式都精确成立的最大 $k$。梯形公式对 $f=1,x$ 精确（线性插值本身对这些函数精确），但对 $f=x^2$ 在 $[0,1]$ 上，$$\int_0^1x^2\,dx=\frac13,\qquad T=\frac12(0+1)=\frac12,$$ 误差 $I-T=-\frac16\ne0$，故其代数精度为 $1$。Simpson 公式在第 3 步已证对三次多项式精确；但对 $f=x^4$ 在 $[-1,1]$ 上，$$\int_{-1}^{1}x^4\,dx=\frac25,\qquad S=\frac13[1+4\cdot0+1]=\frac23,$$ 误差 $I-S=-\frac{4}{15}\ne0$，故其代数精度恰为 $3$。精度 $3$ 高于二次插值的次数 $2$，原因是节点对称使三次项的误差自动抵消。

第 2、4 步的误差公式都要求 $f''$ 或 $f^{(4)}$ 在 $[a,b]$ 上有界且连续。若 $f$ 在内部某点间断或不可微，应先在该点拆分积分，再在每段光滑子区间上使用复化公式；跨过间断点套公式得不到通常的误差阶。若端点有代数奇性，例如 $\int_0^1x^{1/2}\,dx$，则 $f''=-\frac14x^{-3/2}$ 无界，$O(h^2)$ 估计失效。第一片误差为 $$\int_0^h\sqrt{x}\,dx-\frac h2\sqrt h=\frac16h^{3/2}.$$ 对第 $k$ 片（$k\ge2$；第一片已单独计算）靠近 $0$ 的区间，$f''\sim(kh)^{-3/2}$，该片误差约为 $h^3(kh)^{-3/2}=h^{3/2}k^{-3/2}$；而 $\sum_{k\ge1}k^{-3/2}$ 收敛，故靠近 $0$ 的片合计 $O(h^{3/2})$，远离 $0$ 的光滑片合计 $O(h^2)$。因此复化梯形总误差为 $O(h^{3/2})=O(n^{-3/2})$。此时可作变量代换 $x=t^2$（$dx=2t\,dt$）把被积函数化为光滑的 $2t^2$，或使用分级网格、带权高斯公式。另需注意：高阶 Newton–Cotes 公式可能出现负权重，数值上不稳定，实际更常用低阶复化公式或高斯公式。
derivationEn: Let $f\in C^2[a,b]$ and let $p_1$ be the linear interpolant $$p_1(x)=f(a)\frac{b-x}{b-a}+f(b)\frac{x-a}{b-a}.$$ The interpolation remainder is $$f(x)-p_1(x)=\frac{f''(\xi_x)}{2}(x-a)(x-b).$$ Since $(x-a)(x-b)\le0$ does not change sign on $[a,b]$ and $f''$ is continuous, integrating and applying the weighted mean value theorem gives $$\begin{aligned}\int_a^b f(x)\,dx-\int_a^b p_1(x)\,dx&=\frac12\int_a^b f''(\xi_x)(x-a)(x-b)\,dx\\&=-\frac{(b-a)^3}{12}f''(\xi).\end{aligned}$$ Moreover $\int_a^b p_1(x)\,dx=\frac{b-a}{2}[f(a)+f(b)]=T$. Hence the trapezoidal remainder (true value minus approximation) is $$I-T=-\frac{(b-a)^3}{12}f''(\xi).$$ When $f''>0$, $I-T<0$, so the trapezoidal rule overestimates the integral.

Divide $[a,b]$ into $n$ equal panels, $h=(b-a)/n$, $x_i=a+ih$. Then $$T_n=\frac{h}{2}\Big[f(a)+2\sum_{i=1}^{n-1}f(x_i)+f(b)\Big].$$ Applying Step 1 on each panel $[x_{i-1},x_i]$ gives $I_i-T_i=-\frac{h^3}{12}f''(\xi_i)$. Summing, $$I-T_n=-\frac{h^3}{12}\sum_{i=1}^{n}f''(\xi_i)=-\frac{nh^3}{12}f''(\xi),$$ where the last step uses continuity of $f''$ and the weighted mean value theorem (all coefficients have the same sign). Since $nh=b-a$, $$I-T_n=-\frac{(b-a)h^2}{12}f''(\xi)=-\frac{(b-a)^3}{12n^2}f''(\xi).$$ Thus the composite trapezoidal error is $O(h^2)$; doubling $n$ reduces it by about a factor of $4$.

Let $f\in C^4[x_0,x_2]$, let $x_1$ be the midpoint and $h=x_1-x_0=x_2-x_1$. Integrating the quadratic interpolant $p_2$ through the three points gives $$\int_{x_0}^{x_2}p_2(x)\,dx=\frac{h}{3}[f_0+4f_1+f_2]=S.$$ To obtain the remainder, use instead the cubic Hermite interpolant $p_3$ satisfying $p_3(x_i)=f(x_i)$ for $i=0,1,2$ and $p_3'(x_1)=f'(x_1)$. Since $p_3$ agrees with $f$ at the three nodes, $S(f)=S(p_3)$; direct verification on $[-h,h]$ (and by translation on any panel) gives $S(1)=2h$, $S(x)=0$, $S(x^2)=\frac{2h^3}{3}$ and $S(x^3)=0$, which equal $\int_{-h}^{h}1\,dx,\ \int_{-h}^{h}x\,dx,\ \int_{-h}^{h}x^2\,dx,\ \int_{-h}^{h}x^3\,dx$, respectively. Hence $S(p_3)=I(p_3)$. The Hermite remainder is $$f(x)-p_3(x)=\frac{f^{(4)}(\xi_x)}{4!}(x-x_0)(x-x_1)^2(x-x_2).$$ With $t=(x-x_1)/h$, $(x-x_0)(x-x_1)^2(x-x_2)=h^4t^2(t^2-1)$, and $$\int_{-1}^{1}h^4t^2(t^2-1)\,h\,dt=h^5\Big(\frac25-\frac23\Big)=-\frac{4h^5}{15}.$$ By the weighted mean value theorem (this factor does not change sign on $[x_0,x_2]$), $$I-S=\frac{1}{24}\Big(-\frac{4h^5}{15}\Big)f^{(4)}(\xi)=-\frac{h^5}{90}f^{(4)}(\xi).$$ The hypothesis $f\in C^4$ cannot be dropped.

Let $n$ be even, $h=(b-a)/n$, and split $[a,b]$ into $n/2$ panels of length $2h$. Summing the panel rule from Step 3 gives $$S_n=\frac{h}{3}\Big[f(a)+4\sum_{i\ \text{odd}}f(x_i)+2\sum_{i\ \text{even}}f(x_i)+f(b)\Big],$$ where $i=1,\dots,n-1$. The error on each panel is $I_k-S_k=-\frac{h^5}{90}f^{(4)}(\xi_k)$. By continuity of $f^{(4)}$ and the weighted mean value theorem, summing gives $$\begin{aligned}I-S_n&=-\frac{h^5}{90}\sum_{k=1}^{n/2}f^{(4)}(\xi_k)\\&=-\frac{(n/2)h^5}{90}f^{(4)}(\xi)\\&=-\frac{(b-a)h^4}{180}f^{(4)}(\xi).\end{aligned}$$ Thus the composite Simpson remainder is $O(h^4)$, and doubling $n$ reduces the error by about a factor of $16$. The number $n$ must be even because each parabolic panel covers two subintervals; $f\in C^4$ is required by the error formula.

The degree of precision is the largest $k$ such that the rule is exact for every polynomial of degree at most $k$. The trapezoidal rule is exact for $f=1,x$ (the linear interpolant is exact for them), but for $f=x^2$ on $[0,1]$, $$\int_0^1x^2\,dx=\frac13,\qquad T=\frac12(0+1)=\frac12,$$ with error $I-T=-\frac16\ne0$; hence its degree is $1$. For Simpson's rule, Step 3 already proves exactness for cubics; but for $f=x^4$ on $[-1,1]$, $$\int_{-1}^{1}x^4\,dx=\frac25,\qquad S=\frac13[1+4\cdot0+1]=\frac23,$$ with error $I-S=-\frac{4}{15}\ne0$; hence its degree is exactly $3$. The degree $3$ exceeds the degree $2$ of the interpolating polynomial because the symmetry of the nodes makes the cubic error cancel automatically.

The error formulas in Steps 2 and 4 require $f''$ or $f^{(4)}$ to be bounded and continuous on $[a,b]$. If $f$ has an interior discontinuity or a point where it is not differentiable, split the integral there and apply the composite rules on each smooth subinterval; applying a formula across a discontinuity does not give the usual error order. If there is an algebraic singularity at an endpoint, for example $\int_0^1x^{1/2}\,dx$, then $f''=-\frac14x^{-3/2}$ is unbounded and the $O(h^2)$ estimate fails. The first panel contributes $$\int_0^h\sqrt{x}\,dx-\frac h2\sqrt h=\frac16h^{3/2}.$$ For the $k$-th panel ($k\ge2$; the first panel was computed separately) near $0$, $f''\sim(kh)^{-3/2}$, so its error is about $h^3(kh)^{-3/2}=h^{3/2}k^{-3/2}$; since $\sum_{k\ge1}k^{-3/2}$ converges, the panels near $0$ contribute $O(h^{3/2})$ in total, while the smooth panels away from $0$ contribute $O(h^2)$. Hence the composite trapezoidal error is $O(h^{3/2})=O(n^{-3/2})$. One may then substitute $x=t^2$ ($dx=2t\,dt$), which makes the integrand the smooth function $2t^2$, or use a graded mesh or a weighted Gaussian rule. Note also that high-order Newton–Cotes rules may have negative weights and are numerically unstable; in practice low-order composite rules or Gaussian rules are preferred.

formulas.note: 单区间梯形公式：用直线代替被积函数，几何上是一个梯形。
formulas.noteEn: Single-panel trapezoidal rule: approximate the integrand by a straight line; geometrically a trapezoid.

formulas.note: 复化梯形公式及其余项：$h=(b-a)/n$。误差与 $h^2$（即 $1/n^2$）成正比，代数精度为 1 次。
formulas.noteEn: Composite trapezoidal rule and its remainder with $h=(b-a)/n$: the error is proportional to $h^2$ (i.e. $1/n^2$) and the degree of precision is 1.

formulas.note: 复化辛普森公式及其余项：$n$ 必须为偶数（每片抛物线覆盖两段）；误差与 $h^4$（即 $1/n^4$）成正比，代数精度 3 次。
formulas.noteEn: Composite Simpson's rule and its remainder: $n$ must be even (each parabola covers two panels); the error is proportional to $h^4$ (i.e. $1/n^4$) and the degree of precision is 3.

formulas.note: 辛普森余项的另一种写法：便于按 $n$ 直接估计误差——$n$ 加倍误差约降为 $\frac{1}{16}$。
formulas.noteEn: The Simpson remainder rewritten in terms of $n$: doubling $n$ divides the error by about 16.

formulas.note: 辛普森公式的来源：对三点二次插值多项式 $p_2$ 积分。$\int_a^b x^k dx$ 对 $k\le1$（梯形）与 $k\le3$（辛普森）精确。
formulas.noteEn: Origin of Simpson's rule: integrate the quadratic interpolant $p_2$ through three points. Trapezoid is exact for $k\le1$ and Simpson for $k\le3$.

properties: 两个复化公式都由分段低次插值（直线/抛物线）的积分导出；辛普森复用同一批函数值，精度却提高两阶。
代数精度：梯形为 1（对 $x$ 精确、对 $x^2$ 不精确），辛普森为 3（对 $x^3$ 精确、对 $x^4$ 不精确）。
误差随 $n$ 的变化：梯形 $R_T\propto n^{-2}$、辛普森 $R_S\propto n^{-4}$，$n$ 加倍时误差分别约缩小 4 倍与 16 倍。
复化辛普森要求 $n$ 为偶数——每个抛物线片覆盖两个子区间；$n$ 为奇数时需要对最后几段特殊处理。
误差公式假设 $f$ 足够光滑：若 $f''$ 或 $f^{(4)}$ 无界（尖点、间断），估计失效，应改用自适应细分或高斯求积。
propertiesEn: Both composite rules come from integrating piecewise low-degree interpolants; Simpson reuses the same function values yet gains two orders of accuracy.
Degree of precision: 1 for the trapezoidal rule (exact for $x$, not for $x^2$) and 3 for Simpson (exact for $x^3$, not for $x^4$).
Error scaling: $R_T\propto n^{-2}$ and $R_S\propto n^{-4}$; doubling $n$ shrinks them by about 4 and 16.
Composite Simpson requires even $n$ — each parabolic panel covers two subintervals; odd $n$ needs special treatment of the last pieces.
The error formulas assume smoothness: unbounded $f''$ or $f^{(4)}$ (corners, discontinuities) breaks the estimates; use adaptive refinement or Gaussian quadrature instead.

examples.problem: 用 $n=4$ 的复化梯形公式和复化辛普森公式计算 $\int_0^2 x^2\,dx$，并与真值 $\frac83$ 比较。
计算 $\int_0^{\pi}\sin x\,dx=2$，比较 $n=4$ 的梯形与辛普森结果，并观察 $n$ 加倍时的误差变化。
examples.solution: 梯形 $T_4\approx1.89612$（误差约 $-1.04\times10^{-1}$），辛普森 $S_4=\frac{\pi}{12}(4\sqrt2+2)\approx2.00456$（误差约 $4.6\times10^{-3}$）。把 $n$ 加倍到 8：$S_8\approx2.000269$，误差约 $2.7\times10^{-4}$，比 $S_4$ 的误差小约 16 倍，验证了 $R_S\propto n^{-4}$；相应地 $T_8\approx1.97423$，误差约 $2.58\times10^{-2}$，约为 $T_4$ 误差的 $\frac14$，验证了 $R_T\propto n^{-2}$。

expression.note: 两个复化公式都以节点函数值加权求和；辛普森要求 $n$ 为偶数，精度高得多。
expression.noteEn: Both composite rules are weighted sums of nodal values; Simpson needs even $n$ and is far more accurate.

gaussian-quadrature.definition:
数值积分公式一般写作 $\int_a^b f(x)\,dx\approx\sum_{i=1}^n A_if(x_i)$。牛顿-科特斯型公式（梯形、辛普森等）把节点固定成等距点，只优化权重；高斯求积反其道而行：**节点位置与权重一起优化**，让 $n$ 个节点能精确积分尽可能高次的多项式。可以证明，$n$ 个节点的求积公式代数精度最高只有 $2n-1$，而达到这一上界的唯一选择是取节点为 **$n$ 次勒让德多项式 $P_n(x)$ 的零点**，权重为
$$A_i=\frac{2}{(1-x_i^2)\,[P_n'(x_i)]^2},$$
于是得到标准区间 $[-1,1]$ 上的高斯-勒让德公式
$$\int_{-1}^{1}f(x)\,dx\approx\sum_{i=1}^{n}A_if(x_i).$$

为什么偏偏是勒让德零点？勒让德多项式在 $[-1,1]$ 上关于权 1 正交。取 $P_n$ 的零点作节点后，任何次数低于 $n$ 的多项式 $q$ 都可写成 $P_0,\dots,P_{n-1}$ 的组合，故 $\int_{-1}^{1}q(x)P_n(x)\,dx=0$。对任意次数不超过 $2n-1$ 的 $f$ 做带余除法 $f=qP_n+r$（$\deg q,\deg r\le n-1$）：积分只留下 $\int r$；而求积公式作用在 $f$ 上时，$P_n(x_i)=0$ 使含 $qP_n$ 的项全部消失，只剩在 $r$ 上的作用——$n$ 个节点恰好能把不高于 $n-1$ 次的多项式精确积分，两边相等。这就是 $2n-1$ 次精度的来源：节点把 $P_n$ 的正交性带进了求积。

低阶公式可以逐一手算核对：$n=1$ 时节点为 $0$、权重 $2$（即中点公式）；$n=2$ 时节点为 $\pm1/\sqrt3$、权重都是 $1$；$n=3$ 时节点为 $0,\pm\sqrt{3/5}$，权重为 $8/9,5/9,5/9$。注意效率对比：辛普森公式用 3 个等距节点才达到 3 次代数精度，而两点高斯公式只用 2 个节点就做到同一件事；$n$ 点高斯的 $2n-1$ 次精度正是「不浪费节点」的含义。

一般区间 $[a,b]$ 上先作线性变换 $x=\frac{a+b}{2}+\frac{b-a}{2}\,t$（$t\in[-1,1]$，$dx=\frac{b-a}{2}\,dt$）：
$$\int_a^b f(x)\,dx=\frac{b-a}{2}\int_{-1}^{1}f\!\left(\frac{a+b}{2}+\frac{b-a}{2}t\right)dt,$$
再套用标准节点与权重即可。当 $f\in C^{2n}[a,b]$ 时误差为
$$R_n=\frac{(b-a)^{2n+1}(n!)^4}{(2n+1)[(2n)!]^3}f^{(2n)}(\xi),$$
与 $f$ 的第 $2n$ 阶导数成正比：对光滑函数增大 $n$ 收敛极快；但对不光滑、有奇性、或在宽区间上高阶导数很大的函数（如 $e^{-x^2}$ 在 $[-2,2]$ 上），固定阶数的误差未必随节点数迅速降低，这时常先把区间分段、每个子区间再用低阶高斯公式。
gaussian-quadrature.definitionEn:
A numerical integration rule is written $\int_a^b f(x)\,dx\approx\sum_{i=1}^n A_if(x_i)$. Newton-Cotes rules (trapezoid, Simpson) fix equispaced nodes and optimise only the weights; Gaussian quadrature does the opposite: it **optimises node positions and weights together**, so that $n$ nodes integrate polynomials of as high a degree as possible. It can be shown that no $n$-point rule can exceed degree $2n-1$, and the unique way to attain this bound is to take the nodes as the **zeros of the $n$-th Legendre polynomial $P_n(x)$**, with weights
$$A_i=\frac{2}{(1-x_i^2)\,[P_n'(x_i)]^2},$$
giving the Gauss-Legendre rule on the standard interval,
$$\int_{-1}^{1}f(x)\,dx\approx\sum_{i=1}^{n}A_if(x_i).$$

Why Legendre zeros? The Legendre polynomials are orthogonal on $[-1,1]$ with weight 1. With the zeros of $P_n$ as nodes, any polynomial $q$ of degree below $n$ is a combination of $P_0,\dots,P_{n-1}$, hence $\int_{-1}^{1}q(x)P_n(x)\,dx=0$. For any $f$ of degree at most $2n-1$ write $f=qP_n+r$ with $\deg q,\deg r\le n-1$: the integral reduces to $\int r$, while the quadrature applied to $f$ kills the whole $qP_n$ part since $P_n(x_i)=0$, leaving its action on $r$ — and $n$ nodes integrate polynomials of degree at most $n-1$ exactly. Hence the $2n-1$ exactness: the nodes import the orthogonality of $P_n$ into the rule.

Low-order rules are easily checked by hand: $n=1$ has node $0$ and weight $2$ (the midpoint rule); $n=2$ has nodes $\pm1/\sqrt3$ with weights $1$; $n=3$ has nodes $0,\pm\sqrt{3/5}$ with weights $8/9,5/9,5/9$. Note the efficiency: Simpson's rule needs three equispaced nodes to reach degree 3, while two Gauss nodes already do the same job.

On a general interval $[a,b]$, first use the linear map $x=\frac{a+b}{2}+\frac{b-a}{2}\,t$ ($t\in[-1,1]$, $dx=\frac{b-a}{2}\,dt$):
$$\int_a^b f(x)\,dx=\frac{b-a}{2}\int_{-1}^{1}f\!\left(\frac{a+b}{2}+\frac{b-a}{2}t\right)dt,$$
then apply the standard nodes and weights. For $f\in C^{2n}[a,b]$ the error is
$$R_n=\frac{(b-a)^{2n+1}(n!)^4}{(2n+1)[(2n)!]^3}f^{(2n)}(\xi),$$
proportional to the $2n$-th derivative: for smooth functions the convergence as $n$ grows is extremely fast, but for nonsmooth or singular integrands — or for wide intervals where high derivatives are huge (e.g. $e^{-x^2}$ on $[-2,2]$) — a fixed low order may improve slowly, and one should subdivide the interval and use a low-order Gauss rule on each piece.
derivation: 设 $w$ 在 $(a,b)$ 上连续、非负且不恒为零（更一般地，只需 $w\ge0$ 且在某个正测度集上为正）。求积公式为 $$\int_a^b w(x)f(x)\,dx\approx\sum_{i=1}^{n}A_if(x_i),$$ 节点 $x_i$ 互异。若该公式对所有次数不超过 $d$ 的多项式精确，取 $$p(x)=\prod_{i=1}^{n}(x-x_i)^2,$$ 则 $\deg p=2n$，$p(x_i)=0$，故右端为 $0$；但 $p\ge0$ 且只在有限个点为零，而 $w$ 在正测度集上为正，所以 $\int_a^bw(x)p(x)\,dx>0$。矛盾说明 $d\le2n-1$：任何 $n$ 点公式的代数精度都不可能达到 $2n$。

设 $w$ 的各阶矩 $\int_a^b w(x)x^k\,dx$ 有限，$\{p_k\}$ 是关于 $w$ 的首一正交多项式，$\deg p_k=k$，且 $\int_a^bw p_kp_l=0$（$k\ne l$）；这样的多项式可由 Gram–Schmidt 从 $1,x,x^2,\dots$ 得到。对正权，$p_n$ 的 $n$ 个零点互异且全部位于 $(a,b)$ 内，取它们为节点 $x_i$。对任意 $\deg f\le2n-1$，作带余除法 $$f(x)=q(x)p_n(x)+r(x),\qquad \deg q,\deg r\le n-1.$$ 由正交性 $\int_a^bw qp_n=0$，故 $\int_a^bwf=\int_a^bwr$。令 $A_i=\int_a^bw(x)\ell_i(x)\,dx$，其中 $\ell_i$ 是节点上的 Lagrange 基函数。因 $r=\sum_ir(x_i)\ell_i$，有 $\sum_iA_ir(x_i)=\int_a^bwr$；又 $p_n(x_i)=0$ 给出 $f(x_i)=r(x_i)$，所以 $\sum_iA_if(x_i)=\int_a^bwf$。故公式对一切 $\deg f\le2n-1$ 精确；结合第 1 步，$2n-1$ 就是最大值。反之，若某个 $n$ 点公式也达到 $2n-1$，令 $P(x)=\prod_i(x-x_i)$；对任意 $\deg q\le n-1$，$qP$ 的次数不超过 $2n-1$ 且在节点处为零，故 $\int_a^bw qP=0$。于是 $P$ 与所有次数不超过 $n-1$ 的多项式正交，必为 $p_n$ 的常数倍；又 $P,p_n$ 都是首一多项式，故 $P=p_n$，节点就是 $p_n$ 的零点。因此达到上界的节点选择唯一（不计次序）。

取 $[a,b]=[-1,1]$、$w=1$，正交多项式为 Legendre 多项式 $P_n$，满足 $P_0=1$、$P_1=x$ 及递推 $$(n+1)P_{n+1}(x)=(2n+1)xP_n(x)-nP_{n-1}(x),\qquad P_n(1)=1.$$ 取 $P_n$ 的零点 $x_i$ 为节点（首一化不改变零点）。由 Christoffel–Darboux 恒等式可得 $$\int_{-1}^{1}\frac{P_n(x)}{x-x_i}\,dx=\frac{2}{(1-x_i^2)P_n'(x_i)},$$ 而 $\ell_i(x)=\frac{P_n(x)}{P_n'(x_i)(x-x_i)}$，故 $$A_i=\int_{-1}^{1}\ell_i(x)\,dx=\frac{2}{(1-x_i^2)[P_n'(x_i)]^2}.$$ 这里用了恒等式 $(1-x^2)P_n'(x)=n[P_{n-1}(x)-xP_n(x)]$，在零点处化为 $(1-x_i^2)P_n'(x_i)=nP_{n-1}(x_i)$。因为 $x_i\in(-1,1)$，有 $1-x_i^2>0$ 且 $[P_n'(x_i)]^2>0$，所以 $A_i>0$；又常数 $1$ 被精确积分，$\sum_iA_i=\int_{-1}^1 1\,dx=2$。

低阶公式可直接核对：$n=1$ 时 $P_1=x$，节点 $0$，$A_1=\frac{2}{1\cdot1}=2$，即中点公式；$n=2$ 时 $P_2=\frac12(3x^2-1)$，节点 $\pm\frac1{\sqrt3}$，$P_2'=3x$，$A_i=\frac{2}{(1-\frac13)\cdot3}=1$；$n=3$ 时 $P_3=\frac12(5x^3-3x)$，节点 $0,\pm\sqrt{\frac35}$，权重依次为 $\frac89,\frac59,\frac59$。验证精度：$n=2$ 对 $x^2$ 有 $\sum_iA_ix_i^2=2\cdot\frac13=\frac23=\int_{-1}^1x^2dx$，对 $x^4$ 有 $\sum_iA_ix_i^4=2\cdot\frac19=\frac29\ne\frac25$，故其精度恰为 $2n-1=3$。$n=3$ 对 $x^4$ 有 $2\cdot\frac59\cdot\frac{9}{25}=\frac25$，与积分一致，因为 $4\le2n-1=5$。

对一般区间 $[a,b]$，令 $$x=\frac{a+b}{2}+\frac{b-a}{2}t,\qquad t\in[-1,1],\qquad dx=\frac{b-a}{2}\,dt.$$ 则 $$\int_a^bf(x)\,dx=\frac{b-a}{2}\int_{-1}^{1}f\Big(\frac{a+b}{2}+\frac{b-a}{2}t\Big)\,dt.$$ 在标准公式中代入后，节点变为 $x_i=\frac{a+b}{2}+\frac{b-a}{2}t_i$，权重整体乘以 $\frac{b-a}{2}$，且 $\sum_iA_i^{(a,b)}=b-a$。若 $f\in C^{2n}[a,b]$，余项（真值减近似）为 $$R_n=\frac{(b-a)^{2n+1}(n!)^4}{(2n+1)[(2n)!]^3}f^{(2n)}(\xi),\qquad \xi\in(a,b).$$ 例如 $n=2$ 时 $R_2=\frac{(b-a)^5}{4320}f^{(4)}(\xi)$。$n$ 增大时误差依赖更高阶导数，光滑函数收敛极快；但若 $f^{(2n)}$ 很大或 $f$ 不光滑，固定 $n$ 未必有效，应把区间分段并在每段用低阶公式。

同一构造适用于非负权函数 $w$：公式 $$\int_a^bw(x)f(x)\,dx\approx\sum_{i=1}^{n}A_if(x_i)$$ 的节点取关于 $w$ 正交的 $p_n$ 的零点，权重 $A_i=\int_a^bw\ell_i$（对正权，Gauss 权重 $A_i>0$），代数精度仍为 $2n-1$；此时区间可以无限，有限端点可以带可积奇性，只要各阶矩 $\int_a^bw(x)|x|^k\,dx$ 有限。常见例子：Chebyshev 权 $w=(1-x^2)^{-1/2}$ 在 $[-1,1]$，节点 $\cos\frac{(2i-1)\pi}{2n}$，权重 $\frac{\pi}{n}$；Hermite 权 $w=e^{-x^2}$ 在 $\mathbb R$；Laguerre 权 $w=e^{-x}$ 在 $[0,\infty)$。若端点有代数奇性，也可用 Jacobi 权 $w=(1-x)^\alpha(1+x)^\beta$（$\alpha,\beta>-1$）把奇性吸收进权重。反之，若 $w$ 变号或矩不存在，正交多项式理论的标准结论不能直接套用，不能据此断言 $2n-1$ 的精度。
derivationEn: Let $w$ be continuous, nonnegative and not identically zero on $(a,b)$ (more generally, it suffices that $w\ge0$ and $w>0$ on a set of positive measure). Consider the quadrature rule $$\int_a^b w(x)f(x)\,dx\approx\sum_{i=1}^{n}A_if(x_i),$$ with distinct nodes $x_i$. If the rule is exact for every polynomial of degree at most $d$, take $$p(x)=\prod_{i=1}^{n}(x-x_i)^2.$$ Then $\deg p=2n$ and $p(x_i)=0$, so the right-hand side is $0$; but $p\ge0$ and vanishes only at finitely many points, while $w>0$ on a set of positive measure, so $\int_a^bw(x)p(x)\,dx>0$. This contradiction shows $d\le2n-1$: no $n$-point rule can have degree $2n$.

Assume the moments $\int_a^b w(x)x^k\,dx$ are finite, and let $\{p_k\}$ be the monic orthogonal polynomials with respect to $w$: $\deg p_k=k$ and $\int_a^bw p_kp_l=0$ for $k\ne l$; they are obtained from $1,x,x^2,\dots$ by Gram–Schmidt. For a positive weight, the $n$ zeros of $p_n$ are distinct and lie in $(a,b)$; take them as the nodes $x_i$. For any $f$ with $\deg f\le2n-1$, divide with remainder $$f(x)=q(x)p_n(x)+r(x),\qquad \deg q,\deg r\le n-1.$$ By orthogonality $\int_a^bw qp_n=0$, so $\int_a^bwf=\int_a^bwr$. Let $A_i=\int_a^bw(x)\ell_i(x)\,dx$, where $\ell_i$ are the Lagrange basis functions at the nodes. Since $r=\sum_ir(x_i)\ell_i$, we have $\sum_iA_ir(x_i)=\int_a^bwr$; and $p_n(x_i)=0$ gives $f(x_i)=r(x_i)$, hence $\sum_iA_if(x_i)=\int_a^bwf$. Thus the rule is exact for every $f$ of degree at most $2n-1$; combined with Step 1, $2n-1$ is the maximum. Conversely, if some $n$-point rule also attains $2n-1$, let $P(x)=\prod_i(x-x_i)$. For every $q$ of degree at most $n-1$, the polynomial $qP$ has degree at most $2n-1$ and vanishes at the nodes, so $\int_a^bw qP=0$. Hence $P$ is orthogonal to every polynomial of degree at most $n-1$, so $P$ is a constant multiple of $p_n$; since both are monic, $P=p_n$, and the nodes are exactly the zeros of $p_n$. Thus the node choice attaining the bound is unique up to ordering.

Take $[a,b]=[-1,1]$ and $w=1$. The orthogonal polynomials are the Legendre polynomials $P_n$, with $P_0=1$, $P_1=x$, the recurrence $$(n+1)P_{n+1}(x)=(2n+1)xP_n(x)-nP_{n-1}(x),\qquad P_n(1)=1.$$ Take the zeros $x_i$ of $P_n$ as nodes (monic normalization does not change the zeros). The Christoffel–Darboux identity gives $$\int_{-1}^{1}\frac{P_n(x)}{x-x_i}\,dx=\frac{2}{(1-x_i^2)P_n'(x_i)},$$ and since $\ell_i(x)=\frac{P_n(x)}{P_n'(x_i)(x-x_i)}$, the weights are $$A_i=\int_{-1}^{1}\ell_i(x)\,dx=\frac{2}{(1-x_i^2)[P_n'(x_i)]^2}.$$ Here we used $(1-x^2)P_n'(x)=n[P_{n-1}(x)-xP_n(x)]$, which at a zero becomes $(1-x_i^2)P_n'(x_i)=nP_{n-1}(x_i)$. Because $x_i\in(-1,1)$, $1-x_i^2>0$ and $[P_n'(x_i)]^2>0$, so $A_i>0$; and since the constant $1$ is integrated exactly, $\sum_iA_i=\int_{-1}^1 1\,dx=2$.

The low-order rules can be checked directly: for $n=1$, $P_1=x$, the node is $0$ and $A_1=\frac{2}{1\cdot1}=2$, the midpoint rule; for $n=2$, $P_2=\frac12(3x^2-1)$, the nodes are $\pm\frac1{\sqrt3}$, $P_2'=3x$, and $A_i=\frac{2}{(1-\frac13)\cdot3}=1$; for $n=3$, $P_3=\frac12(5x^3-3x)$, the nodes are $0,\pm\sqrt{\frac35}$, with weights $\frac89,\frac59,\frac59$. Accuracy check: for $n=2$ and $x^2$, $\sum_iA_ix_i^2=2\cdot\frac13=\frac23=\int_{-1}^1x^2dx$, while for $x^4$, $\sum_iA_ix_i^4=2\cdot\frac19=\frac29\ne\frac25$, so the degree is exactly $2n-1=3$. For $n=3$ and $x^4$, $2\cdot\frac59\cdot\frac{9}{25}=\frac25$, consistent with the integral because $4\le2n-1=5$.

For a general interval $[a,b]$, set $$x=\frac{a+b}{2}+\frac{b-a}{2}t,\qquad t\in[-1,1],\qquad dx=\frac{b-a}{2}\,dt.$$ Then $$\int_a^bf(x)\,dx=\frac{b-a}{2}\int_{-1}^{1}f\Big(\frac{a+b}{2}+\frac{b-a}{2}t\Big)\,dt.$$ After substitution into the standard rule, the nodes become $x_i=\frac{a+b}{2}+\frac{b-a}{2}t_i$, all weights are multiplied by $\frac{b-a}{2}$, and $\sum_iA_i^{(a,b)}=b-a$. If $f\in C^{2n}[a,b]$, the remainder (true value minus approximation) is $$R_n=\frac{(b-a)^{2n+1}(n!)^4}{(2n+1)[(2n)!]^3}f^{(2n)}(\xi),\qquad \xi\in(a,b).$$ For example, for $n=2$, $R_2=\frac{(b-a)^5}{4320}f^{(4)}(\xi)$. As $n$ grows the error involves higher derivatives, so smooth integrands converge extremely fast; but if $f^{(2n)}$ is large or $f$ is not smooth, a fixed $n$ may be ineffective, and one should subdivide the interval and use a low-order rule on each piece.

The same construction applies to a nonnegative weight function $w$: the rule $$\int_a^bw(x)f(x)\,dx\approx\sum_{i=1}^{n}A_if(x_i)$$ has nodes at the zeros of the orthogonal polynomial $p_n$ with respect to $w$, weights $A_i=\int_a^bw\ell_i$ (which are positive for a positive weight), and degree of precision $2n-1$; the interval may be infinite, and finite endpoints may carry integrable singularities, provided the moments $\int_a^bw(x)|x|^k\,dx$ are finite. Common examples: the Chebyshev weight $w=(1-x^2)^{-1/2}$ on $[-1,1]$, with nodes $\cos\frac{(2i-1)\pi}{2n}$ and weights $\frac{\pi}{n}$; the Hermite weight $w=e^{-x^2}$ on $\mathbb R$; and the Laguerre weight $w=e^{-x}$ on $[0,\infty)$. For algebraic endpoint singularities one may also use the Jacobi weight $w=(1-x)^\alpha(1+x)^\beta$ with $\alpha,\beta>-1$, which absorbs the singularity into the weight. Conversely, if $w$ changes sign or its moments fail to exist, the standard orthogonal-polynomial theory does not apply directly, and the $2n-1$ conclusion cannot be asserted.

formulas.note: $n$ 点高斯-勒让德求积公式：节点 $x_i$ 是 $P_n$ 的零点，权重由下式给出。
formulas.noteEn: The $n$-point Gauss-Legendre rule: nodes are the zeros of $P_n$, weights as below.

formulas.note: 权重的闭式；所有权重为正，$\sum_i A_i=2$。
formulas.noteEn: Closed form of the weights; all are positive and $\sum_i A_i=2$.

formulas.note: 区间变换：把任意 $[a,b]$ 化到标准区间 $[-1,1]$，权重整体乘以 $\frac{b-a}{2}$。
formulas.noteEn: Change of variables: reduce any $[a,b]$ to $[-1,1]$; all weights are scaled by $\frac{b-a}{2}$.

formulas.latex: n=1:\ x=0,\ A=2;\qquad n=2:\ x=\pm\frac{1}{\sqrt3},\ A=1;\qquad n=3:\ x=0,\ \pm\sqrt{\frac35},\ A=\frac89,\ \frac59,\ \frac59
formulas.note: 最常用的低阶节点与权重；$n=2$ 就有 3 次代数精度。
formulas.noteEn: The standard low-order nodes and weights; the 2-point rule already has degree 3 exactness.

formulas.note: 误差公式（$f\in C^{2n}$）：与第 $2n$ 阶导数成正比，光滑函数收敛极快。
formulas.noteEn: Error formula ($f\in C^{2n}$): proportional to the $2n$-th derivative, hence very fast convergence for smooth functions.

properties: **代数精度为 $2n-1$，且这是 $n$ 节点公式的理论上限**：不存在用 $n$ 个节点达到 $2n$ 次或更高精度的求积公式，高斯公式恰好达到最优。
节点是 $P_n$ 的 $n$ 个互异实根，全部落在 $(-1,1)$ 内部；关于区间中点对称，对称位置的权重相等，且 $\sum_{i=1}^n A_i=b-a$。
所有权重 $A_i>0$，求积时不出现相消放大，数值上稳定；$n\to\infty$ 时对连续函数收敛到积分真值。
精度阶数随 $n$ 成倍增长（误差依赖 $f^{(2n)}$），光滑函数收敛很快；但 $n$ 大时节点需数值求解（牛顿迭代或查表），实际常取低阶公式分段复使用。
与等距公式相比：达到同样代数精度用的节点最少；代价是节点不固定，不能像复合梯形/辛普森那样直接复用前一层的函数值。
propertiesEn: **The algebraic degree is $2n-1$, and this is the theoretical bound for $n$ nodes**: no $n$-point rule can reach degree $2n$, so Gauss achieves the optimum.
The nodes are the $n$ distinct real roots of $P_n$, all inside $(-1,1)$; they are symmetric about the midpoint, symmetric nodes carry equal weights, and the weights sum to $b-a$.
All weights are positive, so no catastrophic cancellation occurs; the rule is numerically stable and converges to the integral for continuous integrands as $n\to\infty$.

The order of accuracy doubles with each added node (the error involves $f^{(2n})$), so smooth integrands converge extremely fast; for large $n$ the nodes must be computed numerically (Newton iteration or tables), and in practice low-order rules are applied piecewise.
Compared with equispaced rules it uses the fewest nodes for a given algebraic degree; the price is that nodes are not reusable across refinements, unlike composite trapezoid or Simpson.

examples.problem: 用 3 点高斯公式计算 $\int_{-1}^{1}x^4\,dx$，并说明结果为何精确。
examples.solution:
节点为 $x=0,\pm\sqrt{3/5}$，权重为 $8/9,5/9,5/9$，于是
$$\sum_{i=1}^{3}A_if(x_i)=\frac89\cdot0+\frac59\left(\frac35\right)^2+\frac59\left(\frac35\right)^2=2\cdot\frac59\cdot\frac9{25}=\frac25,$$
与 $\int_{-1}^{1}x^4dx=\frac25$ 完全一致。原因：$x^4$ 的次数 $4\le 2n-1=5$，落在 3 点高斯公式的精确范围之内。

examples.problem: 在 $[0,1]$ 上用 2 点与 4 点高斯公式计算 $\int_0^1e^{-x^2}dx$（精确值约 $0.7468241$），并与辛普森法比较。
examples.solution:
作变换 $x=\frac12+\frac12t$，权重都乘以 $\frac12$。2 点公式的节点为 $x=\frac12\pm\frac{1}{2\sqrt3}\approx0.2113,\ 0.7887$，得
$$\frac12\left(e^{-0.2113^2}+e^{-0.7887^2}\right)\approx0.746595,$$
误差约 $-2.3\times10^{-4}$，只用了 2 次求值。4 点公式得 $0.7468245$，误差约 $+3.4\times10^{-7}$，也只用 4 次求值。对照：4 段辛普森（5 次求值）得 $0.7468554$，误差约 $+3.1\times10^{-5}$；要到 $1.2\times10^{-7}$ 量级需要 16 段辛普森（17 次求值）。同样的精度，高斯公式用的信息少得多。

expression.note: 标准区间上的 n 点高斯公式；一般区间先作线性变换。
expression.noteEn: The n-point Gauss rule on the standard interval; reduce [a,b] with a linear map first.

matrix-condition.definition:
矩阵既可以看成一堆数，也可以看成线性算子 $x\mapsto Ax$。算子视角下最重要的量是它「最多能把向量放大多少倍」，即由向量范数诱导的**矩阵范数**
$$\|A\|=\max_{x\ne0}\frac{\|Ax\|}{\|x\|}=\max_{\|x\|=1}\|Ax\|.$$
这样定义的范数天然与向量范数**相容**：$\|Ax\|\le\|A\|\,\|x\|$，并满足次可乘性 $\|AB\|\le\|A\|\,\|B\|$——这两条是后面一切误差估计的基石。不同的向量范数给出不同的矩阵范数，最常用的有四种：1-范数（最大列和）、$\infty$-范数（最大行和）、2-范数（最大奇异值）与 Frobenius 范数。最容易记反的是：**1-范数是列和最大，$\infty$-范数是行和最大**；转置恰好把两者互换，$\|A^{\mathsf T}\|_1=\|A\|_\infty$。

2-范数 $\|A\|_2=\sigma_{\max}(A)=\sqrt{\lambda_{\max}(A^{\mathsf T}A)}$ 是最大奇异值：把单位球经 $A$ 映射成椭球后，它是最长半轴的长度。Frobenius 范数 $\|A\|_F=\sqrt{\sum_{i,j}a_{ij}^2}$ 不是算子范数（它不来自某个「最大值」），但与 2-范数相容，且 $\|A\|_2\le\|A\|_F\le\sqrt{r}\,\|A\|_2$（$r$ 为秩），计算方便，常用来估计 2-范数。

实际解方程组 $Ax=b$ 时，$b$ 和 $A$ 都带有测量误差或舍入误差。研究「输入的小扰动会被放大多少倍」，得到的量就是**条件数**
$$\operatorname{cond}(A)=\|A\|\,\|A^{-1}\|.$$
在 2-范数下它等于最大与最小奇异值之比 $\sigma_{\max}/\sigma_{\min}$。由 $1=\|I\|=\|AA^{-1}\|\le\|A\|\,\|A^{-1}\|$ 立刻得到 $\operatorname{cond}(A)\ge1$，且 $\operatorname{cond}(I)=1$；正交（酉）矩阵的 2-范数条件数为 1。几何上，单位球被 $A$ 映成椭球，$\operatorname{cond}_2$ 就是最长与最短半轴之比：条件数越大椭球越「扁」，某些方向的误差被放大得越厉害。若右端有扰动 $\delta b$，解的相对误差满足
$$\frac{\|\delta x\|}{\|x\|}\le\operatorname{cond}(A)\,\frac{\|\delta b\|}{\|b\|},$$
这个界是紧的：存在特定的扰动方向使等号近似成立。经验法则：$\operatorname{cond}(A)\approx10^{k}$ 时，解大约损失 $k$ 位有效数字。

经典病态例子是希尔伯特矩阵 $H_n=\left(\frac{1}{i+j-1}\right)$：$H_3$ 的 2-范数条件数已约 $524$，$H_4$ 约 $1.55\times10^4$，随 $n$ 迅速膨胀。判断病态必须看条件数而不是行列式：$10^{-6}I$ 的行列式是 $10^{-18}$ 却完全良态（条件数为 1）。消元法的误差、迭代法的收敛速度都与 $\operatorname{cond}(A)$ 直接挂钩，因此对病态问题常要先做**预处理**或改用更高精度。
matrix-condition.definitionEn:
